-- Row-definition tables for the Properties panel type sections. Returns a constructor so
-- each buildProperties() call gets fresh tables, exactly as the former locals did.
-- Consumed by BuildProperties.buildProperties via W.buildTypeSection.
--
-- Section vocabulary shared by every type (docs/qp2-roadmap/PANEL_LAYOUT_PROPOSAL.md). Display
-- order is PropertyCatalog.SECTION_RANK: Emission > Appearance (Blender right under it) > Spawn >
-- Motion > other sections in array order > Events > Advanced. A toggle_group's children always
-- render after the section's other rows, so groups sit last in their section.

return function()
	local partDefs = {
		{name = "Emission", rows = {
			{key="EmissionMode", label="Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Emit","Animate"}, default="Emit"},
			{key="AnimateLoop", label="Loop", type="toggle"},
			{key="Enabled", label="Enabled", type="toggle"},
			{key="Rate", label="Rate", type="input", default="10"},
			{key="Lifetime", label="Lifetime", type="input", default="1, 1", placeholder="min, max"},

			{key="Timescale", label="Timescale", type="graph"},

		{name = "Spawn", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="Orientation", label="Orientation", type="dropdown", options={"None","FacingCamera","FacingCameraWorldUp","VelocityParallel","VelocityPerpendicular"}, default="None"},

			{key="RotOrder", label="Rot Order", type="dropdown", options={"Global","LocalXYZ","LocalXZY","LocalYXZ","LocalYZX","LocalZXY","LocalZYX"}, default="Global"},

			{key="ZOffset", label="Z-Offset", type="input", default="0"},

				{key="Shape",            label="Shape",            type="dropdown", options={"Box","Sphere","Cylinder","Disc"}, default="Box"},

			{key="Acceleration", label="Acceleration", type="input", default="0, 0, 0", placeholder="x, y, z"},

--[[
	ConfigPanel  -  small modal popups for per-property advanced configuration. Currently exposes:

	  openInstancePicker(opts)  -  picks any Instance from Studio Selection.
	    opts.title    : panel title text
	    opts.label    : prompt label above the instance line ("Pick the target")
	    opts.onSet(inst): called when user clicks Set with the currently-selected Instance
	    opts.onCancel() : called when user dismisses

	Future: openAxisLink(opts) for linking SizeX↔SizeY↔SizeZ etc.
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.Log)

local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

return function(deps)
	local W = deps.W
	local T = deps.T

	local _activePanel = nil

	local function closeActive()
		if _activePanel then
			pcall(function() _activePanel:close() end)
			_activePanel = nil
		end
	end

	local function openInstancePicker(opts)
		closeActive()

		local screenGui = W.getScreenGui and W.getScreenGui() or deps.screenGui
		if not screenGui then
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles] ConfigPanel: missing ScreenGui  -  cannot open picker")
			return
		end

		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = "ConfigPanel_InstancePicker"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		-- Tall enough to fit title + context-line + prompt + instance line + buttons.
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 138)
		panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panel.ZIndex = 200
		panel.Active = true
		panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
		panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
		panel.Parent = screenGui
		W.addCorner(panel, T.Corner)
		W.addStroke(panel)
		W.addPadding(panel, 8, 8, 8, 8)
		W.attachPanelBackground(panel)

		-- Title bar
		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = opts.title or "Configure"
		title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
		title.Font = T.Font
		title.TextSize = 12
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.ZIndex = 201
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		title.Parent = panel

		-- Context  -  which items this panel is editing. Stays visible even if user changes Studio
		-- Selection while the panel is open.
		if opts.context and opts.context ~= "" then
			local contextLine = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			contextLine.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			contextLine.Text = "for: " .. opts.context
			contextLine.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
			contextLine.Font = T.Font
			contextLine.TextSize = 10
			contextLine.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			contextLine.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			contextLine.ZIndex = 201
			contextLine.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
			contextLine.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
			contextLine.Parent = panel
		end

		local hasContext = opts.context and opts.context ~= ""
		local promptY = hasContext and 40 or 22
		local instanceY = hasContext and 58 or 40

		-- Prompt
		local prompt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		prompt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		prompt.Text = opts.label or "Select an instance:"
		prompt.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		prompt.Font = T.Font
		prompt.TextSize = 10
		prompt.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		prompt.ZIndex = 201
		prompt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
		prompt.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, promptY)
		prompt.Parent = panel

		-- Selected-instance label
		local instanceLine = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		instanceLine.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		instanceLine.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		instanceLine.Text = "Instance: <nil>"
		instanceLine.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		instanceLine.Font = T.Font
		instanceLine.TextSize = 11
		instanceLine.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		instanceLine.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		instanceLine.ZIndex = 201
		instanceLine.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
		instanceLine.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, instanceY)
		instanceLine.BorderSizePixel = 0
		instanceLine.Parent = panel
		W.addCorner(instanceLine, UDim.new(0, 4))
		W.addPadding(instanceLine, 6, 6, 0, 0)

		-- Buttons
		local function makeBtn(text, col, x)
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
			b.BackgroundColor3 = col
			b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			b.Text = text
			b.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
			b.Font = T.Font
			b.TextSize = 11
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 0, 22)
			b.Position = UDim2.new(x, x == 0 and 0 or 3, 1, -22)
			b.BorderSizePixel = 0
			b.ZIndex = 201
			b.Parent = panel
			W.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4))
			W.addStroke(b)
			return b
		end
		-- Three buttons when opts.allowClear is set, two otherwise. Clear writes
		-- nil through opts.onClear so picker-managed ObjectValue / direct properties
		-- can be unset without leaving the panel.
		local setBtn, clearBtn, cancelBtn
		if opts.allowClear then
			local function makeBtn3(text, col, x)
				local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
				b.BackgroundColor3 = col; b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
				b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
				b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 11
				b.Size = UDim2.new(1/3, -3, 0, 22)
				b.Position = UDim2.new(x, x == 0 and 0 or 3, 1, -22)
				b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.ZIndex = 201; b.Parent = panel
				W.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(b)
				return b
			end
			setBtn = makeBtn3("Set", T.BlobBg, 0)
			clearBtn = makeBtn3("Clear", T.BlobBg, 1/3)
			cancelBtn = makeBtn3("Cancel", T.BlobBg, 2/3)
		else
			setBtn = makeBtn("Set", T.BlobBg, 0)
			cancelBtn = makeBtn("Cancel", T.BlobBg, 0.5)
		end

		local _selected = nil
		-- Recency cache: last non-empty Studio Selection observed during this picker's
		-- lifetime. Acts as fallback when Set is clicked and live Selection is empty  - 
		-- happens when clicking the Set button itself clears focus from Studio Explorer
		-- (Studio quirk: focus shifts to plugin GUI → Selection reported as empty mid-click).
		local _selectedCache = nil
		-- Exclude set built from opts.excludeItems (typically the source items the
		-- picker was opened for) so Set can't accidentally write self-as-target.
		local excludeSet = {}
		if opts.excludeItems then
			for _, ex in ipairs(opts.excludeItems) do excludeSet[ex] = true end
		end
		local function refreshFromSelection()
			local sel = Selection:Get()
			local picked = sel and sel[1] or nil
			-- Skip self-as-target: clear the line so the user has to consciously pick a
			-- different instance instead of accidentally committing self.
			if picked and excludeSet[picked] then picked = nil end
			_selected = picked
			if picked then _selectedCache = picked end
			instanceLine.Text = _selected and ("Instance: " .. _selected:GetFullName())
				or (_selectedCache and ("Instance: " .. _selectedCache:GetFullName() .. " (cached)"))
				or "Instance: <nil>"
		end
		refreshFromSelection()
		-- Register through ConnectionManager so plugin teardown disconnects this
		-- listener even if the picker close path never fires (e.g. plugin disabled
		-- mid-pick). The local `conn` still handles the normal Set/Cancel close.
		local conn = Selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(refreshFromSelection)
		if deps.Connections then deps.Connections["ConfigPanelInstancePicker"] = conn end

		-- 200ms poll: catches Selection states that never fire SelectionChanged during
		-- this picker's lifetime (e.g. Roblox Deferred signal dropping events under load).
		-- Loop exits when panel is destroyed (panel.Parent == nil).
		local _alive = true
		task.spawn(function()
			while _alive do
				task.wait(0.2)
				if not _alive then return end
				local sel = Selection:Get()
				local picked = sel and sel[1] or nil
				if picked and excludeSet[picked] then picked = nil end
				if picked then _selectedCache = picked end
			end
		end)

		local function close(commit)
			_alive = false
			if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
			panel:Destroy()
			if _activePanel and _activePanel.frame == panel then _activePanel = nil end
			-- Commit prefers live Selection; falls back to cache so a Set click that races
			-- with Studio clearing Selection still writes the user's most-recent pick.
			local commitTarget = _selected or _selectedCache
			if commit and opts.onSet then opts.onSet(commitTarget) end
			if not commit and opts.onCancel then opts.onCancel() end
		end

		-- Snapshot Selection on MouseDown  -  fires BEFORE Studio's focus-shift cascade
		-- clears Selection on plugin-GUI click. By the time Activated (MouseUp) fires,
		-- Selection is reported empty. MouseDown runs while Studio Selection still
		-- holds the pick. Mirrored on the panel background so a mouse-down anywhere
		-- in the picker captures the live pick, not just the Set button.
		local function snapshotSelectionNow()
			local sel = Selection:Get()
			local picked = sel and sel[1] or nil
			if picked and excludeSet[picked] then picked = nil end
			if picked then
				_selectedCache = picked
				_selected = picked
				instanceLine.Text = "Instance: " .. picked:GetFullName()
			end
		end
		setBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(snapshotSelectionNow)
		panel.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then snapshotSelectionNow() end
		end)

		-- Run opts.validate(picked) BEFORE closing. When validation rejects, the
		-- panel stays open + the prompt label flashes a hint so the user knows
		-- their pick was wrong instead of seeing the panel vanish silently.
		setBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			-- Force a Selection re-read at click time. Deferred SignalBehavior can let the
			-- Set button fire before our SelectionChanged listener runs, leaving _selected
			-- stale (or pinned to a previous pick like the parent Frame of a CanvasGroup).
			refreshFromSelection()
			-- Live Selection beats cache; cache covers the case where clicking Set itself
			-- caused Studio to report empty Selection (the 0.2s poll captured the last
			-- valid pick before that).
			local target = _selected or _selectedCache
			if not target then
				instanceLine.Text = "No instance selected  -  click one in Studio first"
				instanceLine.TextColor3 = T.Red or Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80)
				return
			end
			if opts.validate then
				local okValid, msg = opts.validate(target)
				if not okValid then
					instanceLine.Text = msg or "Invalid selection  -  pick a different instance"
					instanceLine.TextColor3 = T.Red or Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80)
					return
				end
			end
			_selected = target
			close(true)
		end)
		cancelBtn.Activated:Connect(function() close(false) end)
		if clearBtn then
			clearBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
				panel:Destroy()
				if _activePanel and _activePanel.frame == panel then _activePanel = nil end
				if opts.onClear then opts.onClear() end
			end)
		end

		_activePanel = { frame = panel, close = function() close(false) end }
		return _activePanel
	end

	-- Axis-link picker. opts.axes is a list of full property keys (e.g. {"SizeX","SizeY","SizeZ"}).
	-- opts.current is a table { [axisKey] = primaryKey or nil } reflecting current LinkedTo state.
	-- Set callback receives a linkMap of the same shape (primary axis maps to nil).
	local function openAxisLinkPanel(opts)
		closeActive()
		local screenGui = W.getScreenGui and W.getScreenGui() or deps.screenGui
		if not screenGui then Log.warn("[Part-Icles] ConfigPanel: missing ScreenGui"); return end
		local axes = opts.axes or {}
		if #axes == 0 then return end

		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = "ConfigPanel_AxisLink"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 158)
		panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0; panel.ZIndex = 200; panel.Active = true
		panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true); panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
		panel.Parent = screenGui
		W.addCorner(panel, T.Corner); W.addStroke(panel); W.addPadding(panel, 8, 8, 8, 8)

		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel"); title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = opts.title or "Link axes"; title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
		title.Font = T.Font; title.TextSize = 12; title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.ZIndex = 201; title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16); title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		title.Parent = panel

		if opts.context and opts.context ~= "" then
			local ctxLine = Instance.new("TextLabel"); ctxLine.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			ctxLine.Text = "for: " .. opts.context; ctxLine.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
			ctxLine.Font = T.Font; ctxLine.TextSize = 10; ctxLine.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			ctxLine.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd; ctxLine.ZIndex = 201
			ctxLine.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14); ctxLine.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
			ctxLine.Parent = panel
		end

		-- Build axis-set for sanitizing incoming current state.
		local axisSet = {}
		for _, a in ipairs(axes) do axisSet[a] = true end
		-- Sanitize: drop self-links and any LinkedTo value not in this row's axes list.
		-- Stale or hand-edited bad attrs can otherwise round-trip forever.
		local linkMap = {}
		for _, a in ipairs(axes) do
			local v = opts.current and opts.current[a] or nil
			if v == a or (v ~= nil and not axisSet[v]) then v = nil end
			linkMap[a] = v
		end
		local primary
		for _, a in ipairs(axes) do
			if linkMap[a] == nil then
				local hasFollower = false
				for _, b in ipairs(axes) do if b ~= a and linkMap[b] == a then hasFollower = true; break end end
				if hasFollower then primary = a; break end
			end
		end
		if not primary then primary = axes[1] end
		-- Strip self-links from initial state.
		if linkMap[primary] then linkMap[primary] = nil end

		local prompt = Instance.new("TextLabel"); prompt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		prompt.Text = "Primary axis (others can link to it):"; prompt.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		prompt.Font = T.Font; prompt.TextSize = 10; prompt.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		prompt.ZIndex = 201; prompt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14); prompt.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 38)
		prompt.Parent = panel

		local pillW = math.floor((280 - 16 - (#axes - 1) * 4) / #axes)
		local pills = {}
		-- Side table: TextButton Instance -> axisKey. Roblox Instances don't accept arbitrary
		-- custom fields so attaching `b.AxisKey = ...` would silently fail and downstream reads
		-- would index nil.
		local pillAxes = {}
		-- Axes the user actually touched. onSet writes only these so a Set on a
		-- mixed multi-selection doesn't overwrite untouched per-item state.
		local dirtyAxes = {}
		local function refreshPills()
			for _, p in ipairs(pills) do
				local axisKey = pillAxes[p]
				if axisKey == primary then
					p.BackgroundColor3 = T.BrightGold; p.BackgroundTransparency = 0
					p.TextColor3 = T.PanelBg; p.Text = axisKey .. " *"
				elseif linkMap[axisKey] == primary then
					p.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; p.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
					p.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; p.Text = axisKey .. " ->"
				else
					p.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; p.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
					p.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; p.Text = axisKey
				end
			end
		end
		for i, axisKey in ipairs(axes) do
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Name = axisKey .. "Pill"
			b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 11; b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.ZIndex = 201
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0, pillW, 0, 22)
			b.Position = UDim2.new(0, (i - 1) * (pillW + 4), 0, 56)
			b.Parent = panel; W.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(b)
			pillAxes[b] = axisKey
			pills[#pills + 1] = b
			-- Single InputBegan handler for MouseButton1: shift-held promotes axis to primary
			-- (followers re-anchor to the new primary). Plain click toggles linked-to-primary.
			b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
				local shift = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
				if shift then
					primary = axisKey; linkMap[axisKey] = nil
					for _, other in ipairs(axes) do
						if other ~= primary and linkMap[other] ~= nil then linkMap[other] = primary end
						dirtyAxes[other] = true
					end
				elseif axisKey ~= primary then
					if linkMap[axisKey] == primary then linkMap[axisKey] = nil
					else linkMap[axisKey] = primary end
					dirtyAxes[axisKey] = true
				end
				refreshPills()
			end)
		end
		refreshPills()

		local primaryHint = Instance.new("TextLabel"); primaryHint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		primaryHint.Text = "(shift-click an axis to make it primary)"; primaryHint.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
		primaryHint.Font = T.Font; primaryHint.TextSize = 9; primaryHint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		primaryHint.ZIndex = 201; primaryHint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12); primaryHint.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 84)
		primaryHint.Parent = panel

		local function makeBtn(text, x)
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 11
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 0, 22); b.Position = UDim2.new(x, x == 0 and 0 or 3, 1, -22)
			b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.ZIndex = 201; b.Parent = panel
			W.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(b); return b
		end
		local setBtn = makeBtn("Set", 0); local cancelBtn = makeBtn("Cancel", 0.5)

		local function close(commit)
			panel:Destroy()
			if _activePanel and _activePanel.frame == panel then _activePanel = nil end
			if commit and opts.onSet then opts.onSet(linkMap, dirtyAxes) end
			if not commit and opts.onCancel then opts.onCancel() end
		end
		setBtn.Activated:Connect(function() close(true) end)
		cancelBtn.Activated:Connect(function() close(false) end)
		_activePanel = { frame = panel, close = function() close(false) end }
		return _activePanel
	end

	-- True while either the instance picker OR the axis-link panel is open.
	-- Callers (init.server.lua's SelectionChanged hook) gate handleSelection on
	-- this so a Studio Selection change made WHILE the picker is open doesn't
	-- repopulate the Properties panel out from under the user  -  the picker uses
	-- Selection to read the user's chosen target, but the rest of the plugin
	-- should stay frozen on the source items being configured.
	local function isOpen() return _activePanel ~= nil end

	return {
		openInstancePicker = openInstancePicker,
		openAxisLinkPanel = openAxisLinkPanel,
		closeActive = closeActive,
		isOpen = isOpen,
	}
end

-- Derive 4 text shades from a custom accent color (used only for non-default colors)
function Constants.deriveTextShades(base)
	local h, s, v = base:ToHSV()
	local bright = Color3.fromHSV(h, math.max(0, s * 0.55), math.min(1, v * 1.2))
	local muted = Color3.fromHSV(h, math.min(1, s * 1.15), v * 0.78)
	local dark = Color3.fromHSV(h, math.min(1, s * 1.25), v * 0.62)
	return bright, base, muted, dark
end

-- Check if a color matches the default text accent
local DEFAULT_TEXT_ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(196, 162, 101)
function Constants.isDefaultTextAccent(c)
	return math.abs(c.R - DEFAULT_TEXT_ACCENT.R) < 0.02
		and math.abs(c.G - DEFAULT_TEXT_ACCENT.G) < 0.02
		and math.abs(c.B - DEFAULT_TEXT_ACCENT.B) < 0.02
end

-- Hex conversion utilities
function Constants.color3ToHex(c)
	return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(c.R*255+0.5), math.floor(c.G*255+0.5), math.floor(c.B*255+0.5))
end

function Constants.hexToColor3(hex)
	hex = hex:gsub("#","")
	if #hex == 3 then hex = hex:sub(1,1):rep(2)..hex:sub(2,2):rep(2)..hex:sub(3,3):rep(2) end
	if #hex ~= 6 then return nil end
	local r, g, b = tonumber(hex:sub(1,2),16), tonumber(hex:sub(3,4),16), tonumber(hex:sub(5,6),16)
	if not r or not g or not b then return nil end
	return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)
end

--[[
	HitFilterPanel  -  modal for the type-level Hit Filter row (Modules/Part/HitFilter). Two controls:

	  1. Collision Group dropdown  -  RaycastParams.CollisionGroup string. Sourced from
	     PhysicsService:GetRegisteredCollisionGroups() with "(none)" as the unset option.
	  2. Exclude List  -  multi-instance picker. RaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances ignores
	     each listed Instance + all descendants.

	OnHit, Rocks and Lightning Seek raycasts all read the same filter. Writes go to EVERY item in
	opts.items; one undo step per open/close session. Reuses ConfigPanel.openInstancePicker for Add.

	Returns: { open(opts), close(), isOpen() }
	opts: { items = {...}, onClose = function? }
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.Log)

local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")

return function(deps)
	local W = deps.W
	local T = deps.T
	local ConfigPanel = deps.ConfigPanel
	local EventsSchema = deps.EventsSchema
	local HitFilter = deps.HitFilter
	local ChangeHistoryService = deps.ChangeHistoryService

	local _activePanel = nil
	-- True while an open modal session is collecting writes. closeActive emits the
	-- closing waypoint only when this is true; teardown calls (no session) skip it.
	local _sessionActive = false
	-- Fired once on closeActive when a session is open, so the Events panel's Hit Filter
	-- label refreshes without the user re-selecting the items.
	local _onCloseCallback = nil

	local function closeActive()
		local fireCallback = _sessionActive and _onCloseCallback
		if _sessionActive then
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Hit Filter")
			_sessionActive = false
		end
		_onCloseCallback = nil
		if _activePanel then
			pcall(function() _activePanel:Destroy() end)
			_activePanel = nil
		end
		if fireCallback then pcall(fireCallback) end
	end

	-- Registered group names with "(none)" prepended. PhysicsService returns {{id, name, mask}, ...}.
	local function collectGroupNames()
		local out = { "(none)" }
		local ok, groups = pcall(function() return PhysicsService:GetRegisteredCollisionGroups() end)
		if ok and type(groups) == "table" then
			for _, g in ipairs(groups) do
				if type(g) == "table" and type(g.name) == "string" then
					table.insert(out, g.name)
				end
			end
		end
		return out
	end

	-- Union of every selected item's excludes, deduped.
	local function gatherExcludes(items)
		local seen = {}
		local list = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local _, excludes = HitFilter.read(item)
			for _, inst in ipairs(excludes) do
				if not seen[inst] then
					seen[inst] = true
					table.insert(list, inst)
				end
			end
		end
		return list
	end

	-- Mutators run inside an open modal session; the open/close waypoints bracket them into one undo step.
	local function addExcludeToAll(items, inst)
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do HitFilter.addExclude(item, inst) end
	end

	local function removeExcludeFromAll(items, inst)
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do HitFilter.removeExclude(item, inst) end
	end

	local function setGroupOnAll(items, groupName)
		local value = (groupName == "(none)") and "" or groupName
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do HitFilter.setGroup(item, value) end
	end

	-- nil = mixed, "" = none, else the shared group name.
	local function commonGroup(items)
		local first, set = nil, false
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local v = HitFilter.read(item)
			if not set then first = v; set = true
			elseif v ~= first then return nil end
		end
		return first
	end

	local function open(opts)
		closeActive()
		if not opts or not opts.items or #opts.items == 0 then return end

		-- Only raycasting types carry a filter; surface the mismatch instead of opening a dead modal.
		local originalCount = #opts.items
		local filteredItems = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(opts.items) do
			if EventsSchema.isValidForItem(item, "OnHit") then
				table.insert(filteredItems, item)
			end
		end
		if #filteredItems == 0 then
			Log.print("[Part-Icles] Hit Filter not applicable to this selection  -  Beam / PointLight / Trail / screens do not raycast.")
			return
		end
		opts.items = filteredItems

		local screenGui = W.getScreenGui and W.getScreenGui() or deps.screenGui
		if not screenGui then return end

		-- Open the undo session BEFORE creating any UI. Waypoints inside the modal
		-- collapse into one undo step bracketed by this + closeActive's waypoint.
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Hit Filter")
		_sessionActive = true
		_onCloseCallback = opts.onClose
		-- Legacy per-event filters move to the type level inside the same undo step.
		for _, item in ipairs(filteredItems) do HitFilter.migrateFromEvent(item) end

		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = "HitFilterPanel"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
		-- T.PanelAlpha matches the main settings panel so the parchment ImageLabel
		-- (attached as a sibling at ZIndex 0 via attachPanelBackground) renders
		-- through the panel's solid color instead of being fully occluded.
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 280)
		panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panel.ZIndex = 200
		panel.Active = true
		panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
		panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
		panel.Parent = screenGui
		W.addCorner(panel, T.Corner)
		W.addStroke(panel)
		W.addPadding(panel, 8, 8, 8, 8)
		W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
		_activePanel = panel

		-- Header
		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = "Hit Filter"
		title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
		title.Font = T.Font
		title.TextSize = 12
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.ZIndex = 201
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		title.Parent = panel

		end)

		local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
		scroll.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		scroll.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
		scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 160)
		scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 70)
		scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 6
		scroll.ZIndex = 201
		scroll.Parent = panel
		W.addCorner(scroll, UDim.new(0, 4))
		W.addPadding(scroll, 4, 4, 4, 4)
		local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
		listLayout.Parent = scroll

		local function renderList()
			for _, child in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
				if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not child:IsA("UIPadding") then
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
			local excludes = gatherExcludes(opts.items)
			if #excludes == 0 then
				local empty = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				empty.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				empty.Text = "(no excludes)"
				empty.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
				empty.Font = T.Font
				empty.TextSize = 10
				empty.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				empty.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
				empty.LayoutOrder = 0
				empty.ZIndex = 202
				empty.Parent = scroll
				return
			end
			for i, inst in ipairs(excludes) do
				local row = Instance.new("Frame")
				row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
				row.LayoutOrder = i
				row.ZIndex = 202
				row.Parent = scroll

				local pathLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				pathLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				pathLbl.Text = inst:GetFullName()
				pathLbl.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
				pathLbl.Font = T.Font
				pathLbl.TextSize = 10
				pathLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				pathLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
				pathLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0)
				pathLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
				pathLbl.ZIndex = 203
				pathLbl.Parent = row

				local rmBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
				rmBtn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
				rmBtn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
				rmBtn.Text = "X"
				rmBtn.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
				rmBtn.Font = T.Font
				rmBtn.TextSize = 10
				rmBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, 0)
				rmBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0)
				rmBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
				rmBtn.ZIndex = 203
				rmBtn.Parent = row
				W.addCorner(rmBtn, UDim.new(0, 3))
				rmBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
					removeExcludeFromAll(opts.items, inst)
					renderList()
				end)
			end
		end
		renderList()

		-- Add button
		local addBtn = W.makeButton("AddExclude", panel, "+ Add Exclude",
			UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), T.Gold)
		addBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -22)
		addBtn.ZIndex = 201
		addBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not ConfigPanel or not ConfigPanel.openInstancePicker then return end
			ConfigPanel.openInstancePicker({
				title = "Add Exclude",
				label = "Pick an Instance the hit raycasts should ignore",
				context = (#opts.items == 1) and opts.items[1]:GetFullName() or (#opts.items .. " items"),
				excludeItems = opts.items,
				onSet = function(picked)
					if picked then
						addExcludeToAll(opts.items, picked)
						renderList()
					end
				end,
			})
		end)

		closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			closeActive()
		end)
	end

	local function close()
		closeActive()
	end

	local function isOpen()
		return _activePanel ~= nil
	end

	return {
		open = open,
		close = close,
		isOpen = isOpen,
	}
end

--[[
	MiniSlider  -  Part-Icles V5
	Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle
	Compact horizontal slider for panel headers (graph editor / inventory panel scale): track,
	fill, handle and a value label in one frame. Callers register the returned parts with their
	own theme tracking and disconnect `slider.conns` on teardown.

	MiniSlider.new(parent, theme, opts) -> slider
	  opts: name, min, max, default, width (96), height (16), fmt ("%.2fx"), zIndex (1),
	        onChanged(value) on every move, onRelease(value) on mouse-up after a drag.
	  slider.frame / track / fill / handle / label / conns
	  slider.set(value, silent), slider.get(), slider.onChanged / slider.onRelease (reassignable)

	MiniSlider.bindPanelScale(slider, panel, theme, applyFn)
	  Preview-then-apply for a panel UIScale: dragging shows a translucent outline of the panel at
	  the slider value; applyFn(value) runs on release. Applying live would rescale the slider under
	  the cursor and skew the drag.
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local MiniSlider = {}

local LABEL_W = 28
local TRACK_H = 6

local function addCorner(instance, radius)
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	corner.Parent = instance
end

function MiniSlider.new(parent, theme, opts)
	local width = opts.width or 96
	local height = opts.height or 16
	local zIndex = opts.zIndex or 1
	local fmt = opts.fmt or "%.2fx"
	local minVal, maxVal = opts.min, opts.max

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = opts.name or "MiniSlider"
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
	frame.ZIndex = zIndex
	frame.Parent = parent

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Val"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextColor3 = theme.MutedGold
	label.Font = theme.Font
	label.TextSize = 8
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	label.Size = UDim2.new(0, LABEL_W, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(1, -LABEL_W, 0, 0)
	label.ZIndex = zIndex + 1
	label.Parent = frame

	local track = Instance.new("Frame")
	track.Name = "Track"
	track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	track.BackgroundColor3 = theme.BlobBg
	track.BackgroundTransparency = theme.BlobAlpha
	track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(LABEL_W + 4), 0, TRACK_H)
	track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -TRACK_H / 2)
	track.ZIndex = zIndex + 1
	track.Parent = frame
	addCorner(track, 3)

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Name = "Fill"
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = theme.SliderFill or theme.Gold
	fill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
	fill.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
	fill.ZIndex = zIndex + 2
	fill.Parent = track
	addCorner(fill, 3)

	local handle = Instance.new("Frame")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.BorderSizePixel = 0
	handle.BackgroundColor3 = theme.BrightGold
	handle.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	handle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 10)
	handle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	handle.ZIndex = zIndex + 3
	handle.Parent = track
	addCorner(handle, 4)

	-- One invisible button the full height of the frame catches clicks anywhere along the track.
	local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
	hit.Name = "Hit"
	hit.Text = ""
	hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hit.AutoButtonColor = false
	hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
	hit.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -height / 2)
	hit.ZIndex = zIndex + 4
	hit.Parent = track

	local slider = { frame = frame, track = track, fill = fill, handle = handle, label = label, conns = {} }
	slider.onChanged = opts.onChanged
	slider.onRelease = opts.onRelease

	local current = opts.default or minVal
	local dragging = false

	function slider.set(value, silent)
		current = math.clamp(value, minVal, maxVal)
		local alpha = (current - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
		handle.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		label.Text = string.format(fmt, current)
		if not silent and slider.onChanged then slider.onChanged(current) end
	end

	function slider.get()
		return current
	end

	local function updateFromInput(input)
		local trackX, trackW = track.AbsolutePosition.X, track.AbsoluteSize.X
		if trackW <= 0 then return end
		slider.set(minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * math.clamp((input.Position.X - trackX) / trackW, 0, 1))
	end

	hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
		dragging = true
		updateFromInput(input)
	end)
	table.insert(slider.conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then updateFromInput(input) end
	end))
	table.insert(slider.conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
		dragging = false
		if slider.onRelease then slider.onRelease(current) end
	end))

	slider.set(current, true)
	return slider
end

-- Product of the UIScales above `panel` (Position / AbsolutePosition live in that space).
local function outerScale(panel)
	local scale = 1
	local node = panel.Parent
	while node and node:IsA("GuiBase2d") do
		local uiScale = node:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		if uiScale then scale = scale * uiScale.Scale end
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return math.max(scale, 0.01)
end

local function makePreview(panel, theme)
	local preview = Instance.new("Frame")
	preview.Name = "ScalePreview"
	preview.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Gold
	preview.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85
	preview.BorderSizePixel = 0
	preview.ZIndex = 100
	preview.Visible = false
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = theme.Gold
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Parent = preview
	addCorner(preview, 8)
	preview.Parent = panel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui") or panel.Parent
	return preview
end

function MiniSlider.bindPanelScale(slider, panel, theme, applyFn)
	local preview
	slider.onChanged = function(value)
		if not preview or not preview.Parent then preview = makePreview(panel, theme) end
		local outer = outerScale(panel)
		local ownScale = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		local size = panel.AbsoluteSize / outer / (ownScale and ownScale.Scale or 1) * value
		local position = panel.AbsolutePosition / outer
		preview.Position = UDim2.new(0, position.X, 0, position.Y)
		preview.Size = UDim2.new(0, size.X, 0, size.Y)
		preview.Visible = true
	end
	slider.onRelease = function(value)
		if preview then preview.Visible = false end
		applyFn(value)
	end
end

return MiniSlider

	The list view stays as it is. A button in the panel header switches between the two:
	  List   the scrolling list of type sections (search box included)
	  Tabs   the sections of one type as a row of chips (wrapping onto a second line when they
	         do not fit) with the chosen section alone underneath. Switching slides the section
	         in from the side, as a tool deck's pages do. A strip down each side of the section
	         carries an arrow: clicking it, or turning the mouse wheel over it, steps to the
	         previous / next section and on into the neighbouring type, and past the last one
	         round to the first. The wheel anywhere else behaves as usual. The panel grows to hold a taller section and never shrinks by
	         itself. With several types selected, a row of type chips sits above.

	PropertiesTabs.create(W, panel, parts) -> tabs
	  parts = { header, searchWrap, searchBox, scroll, top }   top = y of the area under the header
	  tabs.CollapseProbe      add it LAST to the header arrow's item list: the arrow hides and
	                          shows it with the list, which is how this view follows a collapse
	  tabs.Host               the ScrollingFrame the pages sit in
	  tabs.attach()           call once every type section exists under `scroll`
	  tabs.bindStore(plugin)  restores the saved view, then persists changes
	  tabs.setMode("list" | "tabs")

	Type sections are the children of `scroll` built by W.makeSection (`Header/Title` + `Body`).
	Mutates LIVE list frames through Pages alone (adopt reparents them and opens their Body,
	release undoes both); a type is adopted the first time it is opened. The list's own
	Visible flags (set by SelectionHandler) decide which types and sections get a chip.
	Mutates panel.Size while in Tabs (grow only; the user's own resize is kept when the open
	section fits it); the list's height is put back on return to List.
	Refreshed by: a type or section Visible / Title changing, the open section resizing, the
	panel resizing, theme changes.
	Cross-file invariant: W.makeDropdown switches off its ScrollingFrame ancestor's
	ScrollingEnabled while the cursor rests on it. Host is that ancestor here, and every page
	change switches it back on, because a dropdown can leave with its page.
	Plugin setting: PropsViewMode.
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local ChipRow = require(script.ChipRow)
local Pages = require(script.Pages)
local T = C.T

local PropertiesTabs = {}

local ROW_GAP = 4
-- The panel's UIPadding, both edges together.
local PANEL_PADDING = 12
local MIN_PAGE_HEIGHT = 40
local SCREEN_MARGIN = 8
local STRIP_WIDTH = 12
local STRIP_GAP = 2
-- W.makeResizable's edge handles reach this far into the panel's content area; the side
-- strips stay clear of them so resting on a strip does not arm a resize.
local EDGE_CLEARANCE = 6
local STRIP_DIMMED = 0.65
local WHEEL_COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 0.12
local MODE_SETTING = "PropsViewMode"
-- QOLSearch restores the list 0.05 s after the search text changes; adoption waits for it.
local SEARCH_SETTLE_SECONDS = 0.12

local function contains(guiObject, point)
	local origin = guiObject.AbsolutePosition
	local size = guiObject.AbsoluteSize
	return point.X >= origin.X and point.Y >= origin.Y and point.X <= origin.X + size.X and point.Y <= origin.Y + size.Y
end

function PropertiesTabs.create(W, panel, parts)
	local scroll = parts.scroll
	local mode = "list"
	local collapsed = false
	local switching = false
	local store = nil
	local types = {}
	local typesByKey = {}
	local activeType = nil
	local listHeight = panel.Size.Y.Offset
	local pageHeight = MIN_PAGE_HEIGHT
	local chipsBottom = 0
	-- How much of the open page the screen leaves no room for (view units); 0 when it fits.
	-- Above 1 the page scrolls inside the host.
	local pageOverflow = 0
	-- The panel height in force. Opening a section may raise it, never lower it.
	local heldHeight = 0
	local sizeTween = nil
	local settingSize = false
	local lastWheel = 0

	local area = Instance.new("Frame")
	area.Name = "TabsView"
	area.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	area.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, parts.top)
	area.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -parts.top)
	area.Visible = false
	area.Parent = panel

	-- A ScrollingFrame so a section taller than the screen can still be reached, and so
	-- dropdowns find the ancestor they switch off.
	local host = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	host.Name = "Pages"
	host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	host.BorderSizePixel = 0
	host.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	host.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
	host.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	host.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	host.Parent = area
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, host)

	-- The side strips: click or wheel to step sections.
	local function makeStrip(name, glyph)
		local strip = Instance.new("TextButton")
		strip.Name = name
		strip.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		strip.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		strip.BorderSizePixel = 0
		strip.AutoButtonColor = false
		strip.Font = T.Font
		strip.TextSize = 9
		strip.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		strip.Text = glyph
		strip.Parent = area
		W.addCorner(strip)
		W.addStroke(strip)
		table.insert(W.getThemed().blobs, strip)
		strip.MouseEnter:Connect(function() strip.TextColor3 = T.Gold end)
		strip.MouseLeave:Connect(function() strip.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold end)
		return strip
	end
	local previousStrip = makeStrip("Previous", "\u{25C0}")
	local nextStrip = makeStrip("Next", "\u{25B6}")
	nextStrip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)

	local probe = Instance.new("Frame")
	probe.Name = "CollapseProbe"
	probe.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	probe.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	probe.Parent = panel

	local viewButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	viewButton.Name = "ViewMode"
	viewButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	viewButton.Font = T.Font
	viewButton.TextSize = 9
	viewButton.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
	viewButton.Text = "List"
	viewButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	viewButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -54, 0, 0)
	viewButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 1, 0)
	viewButton.ZIndex = 3
	viewButton.Parent = parts.header

	local function screenScale()
		local screenGui = panel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
		local uiScale = screenGui and screenGui:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		return uiScale and uiScale.Scale or 1
	end

	-- The tallest the panel may get: down to the bottom of the screen from where it sits.
	local function maxPanelHeight()
		local screenGui = panel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
		if not screenGui then return math.huge end
		local scale = screenScale()
		local top = (panel.AbsolutePosition.Y - screenGui.AbsolutePosition.Y) / scale
		local room = screenGui.AbsoluteSize.Y / scale - top - SCREEN_MARGIN
		return math.max(room, PANEL_PADDING + parts.top + chipsBottom + MIN_PAGE_HEIGHT)
	end

	-- Grows the panel until it holds the chips plus the open page. Mutates panel.Size.
	local function applyHeight(animate)
		if mode ~= "tabs" or collapsed then return end
		local wanted = PANEL_PADDING + parts.top + chipsBottom + pageHeight
		local limit = maxPanelHeight()
		pageOverflow = math.max(0, wanted - limit)
		-- The page only scrolls when the screen cannot hold it; otherwise the panel fits it.
		local canvasHeight = 0
		if pageOverflow > 1 then canvasHeight = pageHeight end
		host.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, canvasHeight)
		heldHeight = math.max(heldHeight, math.min(wanted, limit))
		local size = UDim2.new(0, panel.Size.X.Offset, 0, heldHeight)

		local running = sizeTween
		sizeTween = nil
		if running then running:Cancel() end

		settingSize = true
		if animate and panel.Visible then
			local tween = TweenService:Create(panel, W.DeckSlide, { Size = size })
			sizeTween = tween
			tween.Completed:Connect(function()
				if sizeTween ~= tween then return end
				sizeTween = nil
				settingSize = false
			end)
			tween:Play()
		else
			panel.Size = size
			settingSize = false
		end
	end

	local typeRow
	local sectionRow

	local refreshArrows

	-- Stacks the chip rows, the side strips and the page host for the panel's width, then
	-- resizes the panel.
	local function relayout(animate)
		local width = panel.Size.X.Offset - PANEL_PADDING
		local y = 0
		if typeRow.frame.Visible then
			typeRow.frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
			y = typeRow:layout(width) + ROW_GAP
		end
		sectionRow.frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y)
		y += sectionRow:layout(width) + ROW_GAP
		chipsBottom = y
		local inset = EDGE_CLEARANCE + STRIP_WIDTH + STRIP_GAP
		previousStrip.Position = UDim2.new(0, EDGE_CLEARANCE, 0, y)
		previousStrip.Size = UDim2.new(0, STRIP_WIDTH, 1, -y - EDGE_CLEARANCE)
		nextStrip.Position = UDim2.new(1, -EDGE_CLEARANCE, 0, y)
		nextStrip.Size = UDim2.new(0, STRIP_WIDTH, 1, -y - EDGE_CLEARANCE)
		host.Position = UDim2.new(0, inset, 0, y)
		host.Size = UDim2.new(1, -inset * 2, 1, -y)
		refreshArrows()
		applyHeight(animate)
	end

	local pages
	local refreshSections

	pages = Pages.new(W, host, {
		onHeight = function(height)
			pageHeight = height
			applyHeight(true)
		end,
		onShownChanged = function(typeKey)
			if mode == "tabs" and activeType and activeType.key == typeKey then refreshSections() end
		end,
	})

	-- Pages are ordered by type, then by section, which gives a slide its direction.
	local function rankOf(page)
		return typesByKey[page.typeKey].rank * 1000 + page.index
	end

	-- stepDirection (optional) is the way a step is travelling: a step that wraps round keeps
	-- sliding that way instead of following the page order.
	local function openPage(page, animate, stepDirection)
		local direction = 1
		local current = pages.active
		if page and current and rankOf(page) < rankOf(current) then direction = -1 end
		if stepDirection then direction = stepDirection end
		host.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		-- A dropdown that left with its page never saw the cursor leave it.
		host.ScrollingEnabled = true
		pages:open(page, direction, animate)
		refreshArrows()
		if page then
			typesByKey[page.typeKey].lastKey = page.key
			sectionRow:setActive(page.key)
			return
		end
		sectionRow:setActive(nil)
		pageHeight = MIN_PAGE_HEIGHT
		applyHeight(animate)
	end

	local function shownTypes()
		local shown = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(types) do
			if entry.frame.Visible then table.insert(shown, entry) end
		end
		return shown
	end

	-- Fills the section chips for the active type. Returns its shown pages.
	local function fillSectionChips()
		local shown = {}
		if activeType then shown = pages:shown(activeType.key) end
		local chips = {}
		for _, page in ipairs(shown) do
			table.insert(chips, { key = page.key, text = page.title })
		end
		sectionRow:setChips(chips)
		return shown
	end

	-- A section of the active type was shown or hidden: the chips follow, and the open page
	-- changes only when it is the one that went away.
	function refreshSections()
		local shown = fillSectionChips()
		local current = pages.active
		if current and table.find(shown, current) then
			sectionRow:setActive(current.key)
		else
			openPage(shown[1], false)
		end
		relayout(false)
	end

	-- Opens `entry`'s sections, adopting them on first use. which: "remembered" returns to
	-- the section last open in that type, "first" / "last" pick an end.
	local function openType(entry, which, animate, stepDirection)
		activeType = entry
		if not entry then
			typeRow:setActive(nil)
			fillSectionChips()
			openPage(nil, false)
			relayout(false)
			return
		end
		typeRow:setActive(entry.key)
		pages:adopt(entry.key, entry.body)
		local shown = fillSectionChips()
		local target = shown[1]
		if which == "last" then
			target = shown[#shown]
		elseif which == "remembered" then
			for _, page in ipairs(shown) do
				if page.key == entry.lastKey then target = page end
			end
		end
		openPage(target, animate, stepDirection)
		relayout(animate)
	end

	local function refreshTypes()
		local shown = shownTypes()
		local chips = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(shown) do
			table.insert(chips, { key = entry.key, text = entry.title.Text })
		end
		typeRow:setChips(chips)
		typeRow.frame.Visible = #shown > 1
		if mode ~= "tabs" then return end
		if not activeType or not activeType.frame.Visible then
			openType(shown[1], "remembered", false)
		else
			typeRow:setActive(activeType.key)
			relayout(false)
		end
	end

	-- What lies `step` away from the open page: a page of the active type, or else the
	-- neighbouring type to carry on into. Either end wraps round to the other; nil, nil only
	-- when there is nowhere else to go.
	local function neighbourOf(step)
		if not activeType then return nil, nil end
		local shown = pages:shown(activeType.key)
		local index = table.find(shown, pages.active) or 0
		local page = shown[index + step]
		if page then return page, nil end

		local shownList = shownTypes()
		local typeAt = table.find(shownList, activeType)
		if typeAt and #shownList > 1 then
			return nil, shownList[(typeAt + step - 1) % #shownList + 1]
		end

		if #shown < 2 then return nil, nil end
		if step > 0 then return shown[1], nil end
		return shown[#shown], nil
	end

	local function stepSection(step)
		local page, entry = neighbourOf(step)
		if page then
			openPage(page, true, step)
		elseif entry and step > 0 then
			openType(entry, "first", true, step)
		elseif entry then
			openType(entry, "last", true, step)
		end
	end

	-- Dims an arrow that has nowhere to go.
	function refreshArrows()
		local previousPage, previousType = neighbourOf(-1)
		local nextPage, nextType = neighbourOf(1)
		previousStrip.TextTransparency = (previousPage or previousType) and 0 or STRIP_DIMMED
		nextStrip.TextTransparency = (nextPage or nextType) and 0 or STRIP_DIMMED
	end

	typeRow = ChipRow.new(W, area, function(key)
		local entry = typesByKey[key]
		if entry and entry ~= activeType then openType(entry, "remembered", true) end
	end)
	typeRow.frame.Name = "TypeChips"
	typeRow.frame.Visible = false
	sectionRow = ChipRow.new(W, area, function(key)
		if not activeType then return end
		for _, page in ipairs(pages:shown(activeType.key)) do
			if page.key == key then openPage(page, true) end
		end
	end)
	sectionRow.frame.Name = "SectionChips"

	local function applyVisibility()
		area.Visible = mode == "tabs" and not collapsed
		viewButton.Visible = not collapsed
		if mode == "tabs" then
			scroll.Visible = false
			parts.searchWrap.Visible = false
		elseif not collapsed then
			scroll.Visible = true
			parts.searchWrap.Visible = true
		end
		viewButton.Text = mode == "tabs" and "Tabs" or "List"
	end

	-- True when another top-level frame of the ScreenGui is drawn over the panel at `point`
	-- (a floating editor, an open dropdown list): the wheel belongs to that one.
	local function coveredAt(point)
		local screenGui = panel.Parent
		if not screenGui then return false end
		local pastPanel = false
		for _, sibling in ipairs(screenGui:GetChildren()) do
			if sibling == panel then
				pastPanel = true
			elseif sibling:IsA("GuiObject") and sibling.Visible then
				local above = sibling.ZIndex > panel.ZIndex or (sibling.ZIndex == panel.ZIndex and pastPanel)
				if above and contains(sibling, point) then return true end
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local tabs = {}

	function tabs.setMode(nextMode)
		if nextMode == mode or collapsed or switching then return end
		switching = true
		if nextMode == "tabs" then
			if parts.searchBox.Text ~= "" then
				parts.searchBox.Text = ""
				task.wait(SEARCH_SETTLE_SECONDS)
			end
			listHeight = panel.Size.Y.Offset
			heldHeight = 0
			mode = "tabs"
			applyVisibility()
			activeType = nil
			refreshTypes()
		else
			mode = "list"
			pages:release()
			activeType = nil
			applyVisibility()
			local running = sizeTween
			sizeTween = nil
			if running then running:Cancel() end
			settingSize = false
			panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, panel.Size.X.Offset, 0, listHeight)
		end
		switching = false
		if store then pcall(function() store:SetSetting(MODE_SETTING, mode) end) end
	end

	function tabs.attach()
		for _, frame in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
			local header = frame:IsA("Frame") and frame:FindFirstChild("Header")
			local title = header and header:FindFirstChild("Title")
			local body = frame:FindFirstChild("Body")
			if title and body then
				-- lastKey: the section last open in this type. rank: its place in type order.
				local entry = { key = frame.Name, frame = frame, body = body, title = title, lastKey = nil, rank = 0 }
				table.insert(types, entry)
				typesByKey[entry.key] = entry
				frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(refreshTypes)
				title:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(refreshTypes)
			end
		end
		table.sort(types, function(a, b) return a.frame.LayoutOrder < b.frame.LayoutOrder end)
		for index, entry in ipairs(types) do
			entry.rank = index
		end
		refreshTypes()
	end

	function tabs.bindStore(pluginRef)
		store = pluginRef
		local okMode, savedMode = pcall(function() return pluginRef:GetSetting(MODE_SETTING) end)
		if okMode and savedMode == "tabs" then task.defer(tabs.setMode, "tabs") end
	end

	viewButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		tabs.setMode(mode == "tabs" and "list" or "tabs")
	end)
	previousStrip.Activated:Connect(function() stepSection(-1) end)
	nextStrip.Activated:Connect(function() stepSection(1) end)

	-- The header arrow hides / shows the probe together with the list.
	probe:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		collapsed = not probe.Visible
		applyVisibility()
	end)

	-- A resize from outside (edge drag, Reset Layout, the header arrow) re-wraps the chips.
	-- Its height becomes the one held, raised again if the open page needs more.
	panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
		if mode ~= "tabs" or collapsed or settingSize then return end
		heldHeight = panel.Size.Y.Offset
		relayout(false)
	end)

	table.insert(W.getUISConnections(), UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then return end
		if mode ~= "tabs" or collapsed or not panel.Visible or not activeType then return end
		-- Only over a side strip: the wheel over the page keeps its usual meaning.
		local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		if not contains(previousStrip, mouse) and not contains(nextStrip, mouse) then return end
		if coveredAt(mouse) then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastWheel < WHEEL_COOLDOWN_SECONDS then return end
		lastWheel = now
		if input.Position.Z < 0 then
			stepSection(1)
		else
			stepSection(-1)
		end
	end))

	table.insert(W.getThemed().repaints, function()
		viewButton.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		previousStrip.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		nextStrip.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		typeRow:repaint()
		sectionRow:repaint()
		if mode == "tabs" and not collapsed then relayout(false) end
	end)

	tabs.CollapseProbe = probe
	tabs.Host = host
	return tabs
end

return PropertiesTabs

--[[
	ChipRow  -  a strip of the tool deck's tab chips that wraps onto further lines.

	The chips are placed by hand from measured text widths, so the strip's height is known the
	moment it is laid out: the Properties tabs size the panel from it in the same step.

	ChipRow.new(W, parent, onPick) -> row
	  .frame                     the strip; the owner positions it, :layout sets its height
	  :setChips(list)            list = { { key = , text = }, ... } in display order
	  :setActive(key)            lights that chip
	  :layout(width) -> height   places the chips in lines no wider than `width` (view units)
	  :repaint()                 theme colours
	onPick(key) runs when a chip is clicked.

	Chips are W.makeChip buttons (WidgetDeck). They are reused and never destroyed, because
	makeChip registers each chip's stroke with the themed list for the life of the UI.
]]

local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")

local ChipRow = {}
ChipRow.__index = ChipRow

local CHIP_HEIGHT = 14
local CHIP_GAP = 3
-- W.makeChip pads its text 5 on each side.
local CHIP_PADDING = 10
local MEASURE_BOUNDS = Vector2.new(10000, 100)

function ChipRow.new(W, parent, onPick)
	local self = setmetatable({}, ChipRow)

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Chips"
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	frame.Parent = parent

	self.frame = frame
	self._W = W
	self._onPick = onPick
	self._buttons = {}
	self._chips = {}
	self._activeKey = nil
	return self
end

function ChipRow:_button(index)
	local button = self._buttons[index]
	if button then return button end
	button = self._W.makeChip("Chip" .. index, self.frame, "")
	button.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	button.Activated:Connect(function()
		local chip = self._chips[index]
		if chip then self._onPick(chip.key) end
	end)
	self._buttons[index] = button
	return button
end

function ChipRow:setChips(list)
	self._chips = list
	for index, chip in ipairs(list) do
		local button = self:_button(index)
		button.Text = chip.text
		button.Visible = true
	end
	for index = #list + 1, #self._buttons do
		self._buttons[index].Visible = false
	end
	self:repaint()
end

function ChipRow:setActive(key)
	self._activeKey = key
	self:repaint()
end

function ChipRow:repaint()
	for index, chip in ipairs(self._chips) do
		self._W.paintChip(self._buttons[index], chip.key == self._activeKey)
	end
end

function ChipRow:layout(width)
	local x = 0
	local y = 0
	for index, chip in ipairs(self._chips) do
		local button = self._buttons[index]
		local textWidth = TextService:GetTextSize(chip.text, button.TextSize, button.Font, MEASURE_BOUNDS).X
		local chipWidth = math.min(math.ceil(textWidth) + CHIP_PADDING, width)
		if x > 0 and x + chipWidth > width then
			x = 0
			y += CHIP_HEIGHT + CHIP_GAP
		end
		button.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
		button.Size = UDim2.new(0, chipWidth, 0, CHIP_HEIGHT)
		x += chipWidth + CHIP_GAP
	end

	local height = 0
	if #self._chips > 0 then height = y + CHIP_HEIGHT end
	self.frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
	return height
end

return ChipRow

--[[
	Pages  -  the section pages of the Properties tabs view.

	Each child of a type's list Body (its sections, plus blocks such as the Blender box) rides
	in a `Page` holder under the host, and one page shows at a time, sliding in from the side
	as a tool deck's pages do. The section frames are the LIVE ones the list uses: adopt()
	takes them out of their Body and release() puts them back, so every ref in UI.<Type> keeps
	working in both views.

	A section does not collapse here: adopt() opens its Body and hides the header's Arrow and
	Toggle, release() restores all three. The list's stored collapse state is not touched.

	Pages.new(W, host, callbacks) -> pages
	  callbacks.onHeight(height)          the open page's height in view units: on open when it
	                                      is already known, and whenever it is measured anew
	  callbacks.onShownChanged(typeKey)   the list's owner showed or hid a section of that type
	  .active                             the open page or nil (read only)
	  :adopt(typeKey, body)               no-op for a type that is already adopted
	  :release()
	  :shown(typeKey) -> { page, ... }    pages whose section is visible, in section order
	  :open(page, direction, animate)     direction 1 slides in from the right, -1 from the left;
	                                      page nil closes the open page
	  page = { typeKey, key, title, index, ... }   index = place among its type's pages

	Cross-file invariant: a frame with `Header/Toggle` and `Body` is a W.makeSection section.
]]

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Pages = {}
Pages.__index = Pages

local ORIGIN = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)

-- Arrow, Body and Toggle of a W.makeSection section; nil for any other frame.
local function sectionParts(frame)
	local header = frame:FindFirstChild("Header")
	local body = frame:FindFirstChild("Body")
	local toggle = header and header:FindFirstChild("Toggle")
	if not body or not toggle then return nil, nil, nil end
	return header:FindFirstChild("Arrow"), body, toggle
end

-- The name a page takes from its section.
local function titleOf(frame)
	local header = frame:FindFirstChild("Header")
	local title = header and header:FindFirstChild("Title")
	if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then return title.Text end
	local label = frame:FindFirstChild("Label", true)
	if label and label:IsA("TextLabel") then return label.Text end
	return frame.Name
end

function Pages.new(W, host, callbacks)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Pages)
	self._W = W
	self._host = host
	self._callbacks = callbacks
	self._types = {}
	self._slides = {}
	self.active = nil
	return self
end

function Pages:_screenScale()
	local screenGui = self._host:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
	local uiScale = screenGui and screenGui:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	return uiScale and uiScale.Scale or 1
end

-- Reads the open page's height. A hidden page is not measured: its layout may be stale.
function Pages:_measure(page)
	if page ~= self.active then return end
	local height = page.frame.AbsoluteSize.Y / self:_screenScale()
	if height < 1 then return end
	if page.height and math.abs(height - page.height) < 0.5 then return end
	page.height = height
	self._callbacks.onHeight(height)
end

function Pages:_makePage(typeKey, frame)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = "Page"
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	holder.Visible = false
	holder.Parent = self._host

	local arrow, body, toggle = sectionParts(frame)
	local page = {
		typeKey = typeKey,
		key = frame.Name,
		title = titleOf(frame),
		index = 0,
		frame = frame,
		holder = holder,
		arrow = arrow,
		body = body,
		toggle = toggle,
		bodyWasOpen = body ~= nil and body.Visible,
		height = nil,
		connections = {},
	}

	if body then
		body.Visible = true
		toggle.Visible = false
		if arrow then arrow.Visible = false end
	end
	frame.Parent = holder

	table.insert(page.connections, frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		self._callbacks.onShownChanged(typeKey)
	end))
	table.insert(page.connections, frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
		self:_measure(page)
	end))
	return page
end

-- Moves every GuiObject child of `body` (LIVE list frames) into a page holder.
function Pages:adopt(typeKey, body)
	if self._types[typeKey] then return end
	local entry = { body = body, pages = {} }
	self._types[typeKey] = entry
	for _, child in ipairs(body:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
			table.insert(entry.pages, self:_makePage(typeKey, child))
		end
	end
	table.sort(entry.pages, function(a, b) return a.frame.LayoutOrder < b.frame.LayoutOrder end)
	for index, page in ipairs(entry.pages) do
		page.index = index
	end
end

-- Returns every adopted frame to its list Body as it was, and drops the holders.
function Pages:release()
	self:_finishSlides()
	for _, entry in pairs(self._types) do
		for _, page in ipairs(entry.pages) do
			for _, connection in ipairs(page.connections) do
				connection:Disconnect()
			end
			if page.body then
				page.body.Visible = page.bodyWasOpen
				page.toggle.Visible = true
				if page.arrow then page.arrow.Visible = true end
			end
			page.frame.Parent = entry.body
			page.holder:Destroy()
		end
	end
	self._types = {}
	self.active = nil
end

function Pages:shown(typeKey)
	local shown = {}
	local entry = self._types[typeKey]
	if not entry then return shown end
	for _, page in ipairs(entry.pages) do
		if page.frame.Visible then table.insert(shown, page) end
	end
	return shown
end

-- Ends any slide still running: every holder is back at the origin and a page that was
-- leaving is hidden.
function Pages:_finishSlides()
	for _, slide in ipairs(self._slides) do
		slide.tween:Cancel()
		slide.holder.Position = ORIGIN
		if slide.leaving then slide.holder.Visible = false end
	end
	self._slides = {}
end

function Pages:_slide(holder, target, leaving)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(holder, self._W.DeckSlide, { Position = target })
	table.insert(self._slides, { tween = tween, holder = holder, leaving = leaving })
	if leaving then
		tween.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
			if playbackState ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then return end
			holder.Visible = false
			holder.Position = ORIGIN
		end)
	end
	tween:Play()
end

function Pages:open(page, direction, animate)
	local outgoing = self.active
	if outgoing == page then return end
	self:_finishSlides()
	self.active = page

	local slides = animate and outgoing ~= nil and page ~= nil
	if outgoing then
		if slides then
			self:_slide(outgoing.holder, UDim2.new(-direction, 0, 0, 0), true)
		else
			outgoing.holder.Visible = false
		end
	end
	if not page then return end

	page.holder.Visible = true
	if slides then
		page.holder.Position = UDim2.new(direction, 0, 0, 0)
		self:_slide(page.holder, ORIGIN, false)
	else
		page.holder.Position = ORIGIN
	end

	if page.height then self._callbacks.onHeight(page.height) end
	-- The page lays out on the next frame; its AbsoluteSize signal stays silent when the
	-- size it had while hidden was already right, so the height is read once here as well.
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait()
		self:_measure(page)
	end)
end

return Pages

-- Word-boundary match: start of label or after space/underscore. Query escaped against
-- Luau pattern specials so chars like `(`, `.`, `%`, `[`, `*` match literally.
local function _escapePattern(s) return (s:gsub("[%(%)%.%%%+%-%*%?%[%]%^%$]", "%%%1")) end
local function _labelMatches(label, q)
	local esc = _escapePattern(q)
	return label:sub(1, #q) == q or label:find("[%s_]" .. esc) ~= nil
end

-- Wire search filtering on a scroll frame (call after building toggles).
-- External code (selection-filter, type-toggles) calls
-- `ToolPanels.invalidateSearchSnapshot(searchBox)` when it changes visibility while
-- a search is active. The next clear-search re-snapshots from post-filter state
-- instead of restoring stale pre-filter visibility (which would undo the filter).
function ToolPanels.invalidateSearchSnapshot(searchBox)
	if searchBox then searchBox:SetAttribute("_savedDirty", true) end
end

function ToolPanels.wireSearch(searchBox, scrollFrame)
	if not searchBox or not scrollFrame then return end
	local _saved = {} -- {[frame] = wasVisible} snapshot before search (bodies + rows)
	searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		local query = searchBox.Text:lower()
		local isSearch = query ~= ""
		-- If external code (filter toggle) marked the snapshot dirty, drop it and
		-- re-snapshot from current state. Otherwise clearing search would restore
		-- stale pre-filter visibility and undo the filter's just-applied changes.
		if searchBox:GetAttribute("_savedDirty") then
			_saved = {}
			searchBox:SetAttribute("_savedDirty", nil)
		end
		-- Save state on first search (bodies + rows from selection filter)
		if isSearch and next(_saved) == nil then
			for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name == "Body" or d:GetAttribute("PropRow") or d.Name:match("Section$") or d.Name:match("Sub$")) then _saved[d] = d.Visible end
			end
			for _, s in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetChildren()) do if s:IsA("Frame") then _saved[s] = s.Visible end end
		end
		if isSearch then
			local hits = {}
			for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") and d:GetAttribute("PropRow") then
					local lbl = d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
					if lbl then
						local match = _saved[d] and _labelMatches(lbl.Text:lower(), query)
						d.Visible = match or false
						if match then local c = d.Parent; while c and c ~= scrollFrame do hits[c] = true; c = c.Parent end end
					end
				end
			end
			for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name:match("Section$") or d.Name:match("Sub$")) then d.Visible = hits[d] or false
				elseif d.Name == "Body" and d:IsA("Frame") then d.Visible = hits[d] or false end
			end
			for _, s in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetChildren()) do if s:IsA("Frame") then s.Visible = hits[s] or false end end
		else
			for d, vis in pairs(_saved) do d.Visible = vis end; _saved = {}
		end
		-- Sync arrows
		for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
			local hdr = d:IsA("Frame") and d:FindFirstChild("Header")
			if hdr then local ar = hdr:FindFirstChild("Arrow"); if ar then
				local body = d:FindFirstChild("Body"); if body then ar.Text = body.Visible and "\u{25BC}" or "\u{25B6}" end
			end end
		end
	end)
end

	{name = "Spawn", props = {"Rotation", "ZOffset"}},

-- Value types the Shifter can scale (QOL.shiftItems dispatches on typeof). Booleans, enums,
-- strings, colours and events never reach the Shifter list.
local SHIFTABLE_TYPES = { number = true, NumberRange = true, NumberSequence = true, Vector2 = true, Vector3 = true, UDim2 = true }

local SHIFTABLE_ITEM_ATTRS = { EmitCount = true, EmitDelay = true, EmitDuration = true }

-- Type-name + ctx-field-key constants live in PropertyCatalog (single source of truth).
-- ToolPanels reads via the local alias below; ClipShiftFix reads via
-- `ToolPanels.TYPE_ITEM_KEYS` which we re-expose for backwards compat.
local TYPE_ITEM_KEYS = PropertyCatalog.TYPE_ITEM_KEYS

-- Forwarding shim: body lives in `Modules/PropertyCatalog`. Same return shape.
local function _mergeClipboards(TypeRegistry, peSections, excludeProps, keepFn)
	return PropertyCatalog.merge(TypeRegistry, peSections, excludeProps, keepFn)
end

-- Cached maps (populated during build, accessed by ClipShiftFix via ToolPanels.propTypeMap)

function ToolPanels.buildHueChanger(sg)
	local panel = W.makeToolPanel(sg, "HueChanger", 80, 360)
	local refs = {}
	local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local HANDLE_H = 8

	-- Builds a vertical slider with gradient background. Returns (getVal, setVal, track)
	-- xScale: 0-1 horizontal position (Scale-based for responsive layout)
	local function makeVSlider(parent, xScale, gradient, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal)
		local track = Instance.new("Frame"); track.Name = "Track"; track.BorderSizePixel = 0
		track.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 1, -90); track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		track.Position = UDim2.new(xScale, 0, 0, 26)
		track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1); track.Parent = parent
		local cr = Instance.new("UICorner"); cr.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,4); cr.Parent = track
		local gr = Instance.new("UIGradient"); gr.Rotation = 90; gr.Parent = track
		gr.Color = gradient
		local handle = Instance.new("Frame"); handle.Name = "Handle"; handle.BorderSizePixel = 0
		handle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1); handle.Size = UDim2.new(1,4,0,HANDLE_H)
		handle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5); handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,0)
		handle.ZIndex = 3; handle.Parent = track
		local hc = Instance.new("UICorner"); hc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,3); hc.Parent = handle
		local hs = Instance.new("UIStroke"); hs.Color = Color3.new(0,0,0); hs.Thickness = 1; hs.Parent = handle
		local cur = defaultVal; local dragging = false
		local lo, hi = math.min(minVal, maxVal), math.max(minVal, maxVal)
		local function setVal(v, skip)
			cur = math.clamp(v, lo, hi)
			local t = (cur - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)
			handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, t, 0)
		end
		local function getVal() return cur end
		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton"); btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1; btn.Text = ""
		btn.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); btn.ZIndex = 4; btn.Parent = track
		btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
			if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true end
		end)
		btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
			if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
		end)
		local uisC = W.getUISConnections()
		table.insert(uisC, UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
			if not dragging or i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
			local absY = track.AbsolutePosition.Y; local absH = track.AbsoluteSize.Y
			local rel = math.clamp((i.Position.Y - absY) / absH, 0, 1)
			setVal(minVal + rel * (maxVal - minVal))
		end))
		table.insert(uisC, UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
			if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
		end))
		btn.Activated:Connect(function()
			local m = UIS:GetMouseLocation(); local absY = track.AbsolutePosition.Y; local absH = track.AbsoluteSize.Y
			local rel = math.clamp((m.Y - absY) / absH, 0, 1)
			setVal(minVal + rel * (maxVal - minVal))
		end)
		setVal(defaultVal)
		return getVal, setVal, track
	end

	-- Rainbow gradient for Hue
	local hueGrad = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.167, Color3.fromHSV(0.167,1,1)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.333, Color3.fromHSV(0.333,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromHSV(0.5,1,1)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.667, Color3.fromHSV(0.667,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.833, Color3.fromHSV(0.833,1,1)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1)),
	})
	-- Saturation: white → full color (red as reference)
	local satGrad = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1))})
	-- Value: white → black
	local valGrad = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0,0,0))})

	local hgv, hsv = makeVSlider(panel, 1/6, hueGrad, -0.5, 0.5, 0)
	local sgv, ssv = makeVSlider(panel, 3/6, satGrad, -1, 1, 0)
	local vgv, vsv = makeVSlider(panel, 5/6, valGrad, 1, -1, 0)

	-- Labels (below tracks, same Scale X positions)
	local function addLabel(text, xScale)
		local l = Instance.new("TextLabel"); l.BackgroundTransparency = 1; l.Text = text
