--[[
	WidgetAxis  -  Part-Icles V5
	Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle
	Axis-based widget factories (graph rows, input rows, inline axis selectors).
	Loaded by Widgets.luau  -  receives the shared W table and adds functions to it.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

-- Axis colors lookup
local AXIS_COLORS = {X = T.AxisX, Y = T.AxisY, Z = T.AxisZ}

-- Derive a muted background tint from an axis color (for selected state)
local function axisSelectedBg(color)
	local h, s, v = color:ToHSV()
	return Color3.fromHSV(h, math.min(s * 0.6, 1), v * 0.25)
end

return function(W)
	local addCorner, addStroke = W.addCorner, W.addStroke
	-- Cross-file invariant: each axis button registered here is consumed by
	-- `UIBuilder:UpdateTheme`'s axis-button refresh loop. That loop reads the button's
	-- `_selected` attribute (set by makeInlineAxisSelect/Input/GraphSelect below) to gate
	-- selected-style paint vs default paint. Keep the registered shape `{btn, color, selBg}`
	-- in sync with that consumer.
	local function trackAxis(btn, color, selBg)
		table.insert(W.getThemed().axisButtons, {btn = btn, color = color, selBg = selBg})
	end

	function W.makeAxisGraphRow(parent, axis, color, order, withCheckbox)
		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.Name = axis.."Row"; row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,LAYOUT.RowHeight); row.LayoutOrder = order or 0; row.Parent = parent

		local xOffset = 18
		local checkbox = nil

		if withCheckbox then
			-- Small checkbox (14x14) before the axis label
			checkbox = Instance.new("TextButton"); checkbox.Name = "Checkbox"; checkbox.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
			checkbox.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha; checkbox.Text = ""; checkbox.Size = UDim2.new(0,14,0,14)
			checkbox.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0.5,-7); checkbox.BorderSizePixel = 0; checkbox.AutoButtonColor = false
			checkbox.Parent = row; addCorner(checkbox, UDim.new(0,3)); addStroke(checkbox)
			local checkMark = Instance.new("TextLabel"); checkMark.Name = "Mark"; checkMark.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			checkMark.Text = ""; checkMark.TextColor3 = color; checkMark.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; checkMark.TextSize = 10
			checkMark.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); checkMark.Parent = checkbox
			-- Register checkMark for theme refresh on axis color changes.
			table.insert(W.getThemed().axisColored, { inst = checkMark, prop = "TextColor3", axis = axis })
			row:SetAttribute("Checked", false)
			checkbox.Activated:Connect(function()
				local checked = not row:GetAttribute("Checked"); row:SetAttribute("Checked", checked)
				checkMark.Text = checked and "✓" or ""
				checkbox.BackgroundColor3 = checked and Color3.fromRGB(40,55,30) or T.BlobBg
			end)
			xOffset = 34 -- shift axis label + graph button right
		end

		local axLbl = Instance.new("TextButton"); axLbl.Name = "AxisLabel"; axLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		axLbl.Text = axis; axLbl.TextColor3 = color; axLbl.Font = T.Font; axLbl.TextSize = 11
		axLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0,16,1,0); axLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, xOffset - 18, 0, 0); axLbl.Parent = row
		if withCheckbox then axLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0) end

		local gBtn, gFrame, selLbl = W.makeSelectButton(axis, nil, color)
		gFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,xOffset,0,0); gFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,-xOffset,1,0); gFrame.Parent = row
		return {row = row, axisBtn = axLbl, graphBtn = gBtn, graphFrame = gFrame, selectLabel = selLbl, checkbox = checkbox}
	end

	function W.makeAxisInputRow(parent, axis, color, order, placeholder)
		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.Name = axis.."Row"; row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,LAYOUT.RowHeight); row.LayoutOrder = order or 0; row.Parent = parent
		local axLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); axLbl.Name = "AxisLabel"; axLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		axLbl.Text = axis; axLbl.TextColor3 = color; axLbl.Font = T.Font; axLbl.TextSize = 11
		axLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0,16,1,0); axLbl.Parent = row
		local wrap = W.makeBlob("InputWrap", row, UDim2.new(1,-18,1,0)); wrap.Position = UDim2.new(0,18,0,0)
		local tb = Instance.new("TextBox"); tb.Name = "Input"; tb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tb.Text = "0, 0"; tb.PlaceholderText = placeholder or "min, max"
		tb.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; tb.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold; tb.Font = T.Font; tb.TextSize = 10
		tb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; tb.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		tb.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,1,0); tb.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); tb.BorderSizePixel = 0; tb.Parent = wrap
		return {row = row, input = tb}
	end

	-- =========================================================
	-- INLINE AXIS ROW (compact horizontal X/Y/Z toggles + Edit or Input)
	-- =========================================================

	-- axis_select: [Label] [X][Y][Z] [Edit] [...]   -  for graph properties
	function W.makeInlineAxisSelect(parent, key, axes, order)

		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.Name = key.."Row"; row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,LAYOUT.RowHeight); row.LayoutOrder = order or 0; row.Parent = parent

		-- Axis toggle buttons (right of label area)
		local axBtns = {}
		local selected = {}
		local _onSelChanged = nil
		local btnWidth = 18
		for i, axis in ipairs(axes) do
			local color = AXIS_COLORS[axis] or T.MutedGold
			local selBg = axisSelectedBg(color)
			local ab = Instance.new("TextButton"); ab.Name = axis.."Btn"
			ab.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; ab.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			ab.Text = axis; ab.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; ab.Font = T.Font; ab.TextSize = 10
			ab.Size = UDim2.new(0,btnWidth,0,18); ab.Position = UDim2.new(0, (i-1)*(btnWidth+2), 0.5, -9)
			ab.BorderSizePixel = 0; ab.AutoButtonColor = false; ab.Parent = row
			addCorner(ab, UDim.new(0,3))
			selected[axis] = false
			ab:SetAttribute("_selected", false)
			ab.Activated:Connect(function()
				selected[axis] = not selected[axis]
				ab:SetAttribute("_selected", selected[axis])
				ab.BackgroundColor3 = selected[axis] and selBg or T.BlobBg
				ab.BackgroundTransparency = selected[axis] and 0.15 or T.BlobAlpha
				ab.TextColor3 = selected[axis] and color or T.DarkGold
				if _onSelChanged then _onSelChanged() end
			end)
			trackAxis(ab, color, selBg)
			axBtns[axis] = ab
		end

		-- Edit button (after axis buttons)
		local editOffset = #axes * (btnWidth + 2) + 2
		local editBtn, editFrame, editLbl, dotsBtn = W.makeSelectButton(key, nil, T.MutedGold)
		editFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, editOffset, 0, 0)
		editFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -editOffset, 1, 0); editFrame.Parent = row

		local function getSelected()
			local result = {}
			for _, axis in ipairs(axes) do
				if selected[axis] then table.insert(result, key..axis) end
			end
			return result
		end

		local function setOnSelectionChanged(fn) _onSelChanged = fn end

		return {row = row, axisButtons = axBtns, editBtn = editBtn, editFrame = editFrame,
			selectLabel = editLbl, dotsBtn = dotsBtn, getSelected = getSelected, setOnSelectionChanged = setOnSelectionChanged}
	end

	-- axis_graph_select: [Label] [X][Y][Z] [value] [...]   -  graph-style axis properties
	function W.makeInlineAxisGraphSelect(parent, key, axes, order)

		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.Name = key.."Row"; row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,LAYOUT.RowHeight); row.LayoutOrder = order or 0; row.Parent = parent

		local axBtns = {}
		-- selectedOrder retains click sequence: selectedOrder[1] is "primary" (the axis whose graph
		-- displays in the shared TextBox/EditButton). Differs from makeInlineAxisSelect /
		-- makeInlineAxisInput which use unordered `selected[axis]=bool` because they have no shared
		-- display field that needs a focus axis.
		local selectedOrder = {}
		local _onSelChanged = nil
		local btnWidth = 18
		local primaryStrokes = {} -- UIStroke per axis button (created on demand)

		-- Update primary axis visual indicator
		local function updatePrimaryIndicator()
			for _, axis in ipairs(axes) do
				local ab = axBtns[axis]
				if not ab then continue end
				local stroke = primaryStrokes[axis]
				if selectedOrder[1] == axis then
					-- Primary: bright stroke
					if not stroke then
						stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke"); stroke.Name = "PrimaryStroke"
						stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
						stroke.Thickness = 1.5; stroke.Parent = ab
						primaryStrokes[axis] = stroke
					end
					stroke.Color = AXIS_COLORS[axis] or T.MutedGold
					stroke.Transparency = 0.2
					stroke.Enabled = true
				else
					if stroke then stroke.Enabled = false end
				end
			end
		end

		for i, axis in ipairs(axes) do
			local color = AXIS_COLORS[axis] or T.MutedGold
			local selBg = axisSelectedBg(color)
			local ab = Instance.new("TextButton"); ab.Name = axis.."Btn"
			ab.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; ab.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			ab.Text = axis; ab.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; ab.Font = T.Font; ab.TextSize = 10
			ab.Size = UDim2.new(0,btnWidth,0,18); ab.Position = UDim2.new(0, (i-1)*(btnWidth+2), 0.5, -9)
			ab.BorderSizePixel = 0; ab.AutoButtonColor = false; ab.Parent = row
			addCorner(ab, UDim.new(0,3))
			ab:SetAttribute("_selected", false)
			ab.Activated:Connect(function()
				local wasSelected = false
				for j, a in ipairs(selectedOrder) do
					if a == axis then table.remove(selectedOrder, j); wasSelected = true; break end
				end
				if not wasSelected then
					table.insert(selectedOrder, axis)
				end
				local isOn = not wasSelected
				ab:SetAttribute("_selected", isOn)
				ab.BackgroundColor3 = isOn and selBg or T.BlobBg
				ab.BackgroundTransparency = isOn and 0.15 or T.BlobAlpha
				ab.TextColor3 = isOn and color or T.DarkGold
				updatePrimaryIndicator()
				if _onSelChanged then _onSelChanged() end
			end)
			trackAxis(ab, color, selBg)
			axBtns[axis] = ab
		end

		-- Graph-style blob (TextBox + ... button) after axis buttons
		local editOffset = #axes * (btnWidth + 2) + 2
		local blob = W.makeBlob(key.."Graph", row, UDim2.new(1,-editOffset,1,0))
		blob.Position = UDim2.new(0, editOffset, 0, 0)
		local input = Instance.new("TextBox"); input.Name = key.."Input"; input.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		input.Text = ""; input.PlaceholderText = ""
		input.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; input.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold; input.Font = T.Font; input.TextSize = 11
		input.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; input.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		input.Size = UDim2.new(1,-22,1,0); input.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); input.BorderSizePixel = 0; input.Parent = blob
		local dotsBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); dotsBtn.Name = "DotsBtn"; dotsBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		dotsBtn.Text = "\u{22EF}"; dotsBtn.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; dotsBtn.TextTransparency = 0; dotsBtn.Font = T.Font; dotsBtn.TextSize = 14
		dotsBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,18,1,0); dotsBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1,-18,0,0)
		dotsBtn.ZIndex = 3; dotsBtn.Parent = blob

		local function getSelected()
			local result = {}
			for _, axis in ipairs(selectedOrder) do
				table.insert(result, key..axis)
			end
			return result
		end

		local function getPrimary()
			if #selectedOrder > 0 then return key..selectedOrder[1] end
			return nil
		end

		local function setOnSelectionChanged(fn) _onSelChanged = fn end

		return {row = row, axisButtons = axBtns, input = input, dotsBtn = dotsBtn,
			getSelected = getSelected, getPrimary = getPrimary, setOnSelectionChanged = setOnSelectionChanged}
	end

	-- axis_input: [Label] [X][Y][Z] [input]   -  for value properties
	-- evenAttrs (optional): {X="RotXEven", Y="RotYEven", Z="RotZEven"} or similar. When
	-- present, each axis pill renders a small toggle dot in its top-right corner that
	-- toggles the matching cfg attribute. Dot is gold when ON, dark gold + transparent
	-- when OFF. Click triggers the connector (wired in PropertyInputs.luau via the
	-- exposed `evenButtons` ref). Visual state syncs from cfg in the populate pass.
	function W.makeInlineAxisInput(parent, key, axes, order, placeholder, evenAttrs)

		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.Name = key.."Row"; row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,LAYOUT.RowHeight); row.LayoutOrder = order or 0; row.Parent = parent

		local axBtns = {}
		local evenBtns = {}
		local selected = {}
		local _onSelChanged = nil
		local btnWidth = 18
		for i, axis in ipairs(axes) do
			local color = AXIS_COLORS[axis] or T.MutedGold
			local selBg = axisSelectedBg(color)
			local ab = Instance.new("TextButton"); ab.Name = axis.."Btn"
			ab.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; ab.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			ab.Text = axis; ab.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; ab.Font = T.Font; ab.TextSize = 10
			ab.Size = UDim2.new(0,btnWidth,0,18); ab.Position = UDim2.new(0, (i-1)*(btnWidth+2), 0.5, -9)
			ab.BorderSizePixel = 0; ab.AutoButtonColor = false; ab.Parent = row
			addCorner(ab, UDim.new(0,3))
			selected[axis] = false
			ab:SetAttribute("_selected", false)
			ab.Activated:Connect(function()
				selected[axis] = not selected[axis]
				ab:SetAttribute("_selected", selected[axis])
				ab.BackgroundColor3 = selected[axis] and selBg or T.BlobBg
				ab.BackgroundTransparency = selected[axis] and 0.15 or T.BlobAlpha
				ab.TextColor3 = selected[axis] and color or T.DarkGold
				if _onSelChanged then _onSelChanged() end
			end)
			trackAxis(ab, color, selBg)
			axBtns[axis] = ab

			-- Even-distribution dot in the axis pill's top-right corner. Owned by the
			-- pill (parented to ab) so it tracks the pill's position; ZIndex bump keeps
			-- it on top of the pill's background. Click toggles its `_even` attribute;
			-- the connector reads that attribute on Activated and writes the cfg attr.
			if evenAttrs and evenAttrs[axis] then
				local dot = Instance.new("TextButton"); dot.Name = "Even"
				dot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5); dot.Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 1)
				dot.BackgroundColor3 = T.DarkGold; dot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
				dot.Text = ""; dot.BorderSizePixel = 0; dot.AutoButtonColor = false
				dot.ZIndex = (ab.ZIndex or 1) + 1; dot.Parent = ab
				addCorner(dot, UDim.new(1, 0))
				dot:SetAttribute("_even", false)
				dot:SetAttribute("_evenAttr", evenAttrs[axis])
				dot:SetAttribute("_axis", axis)
				evenBtns[axis] = dot
				-- Register for theme refresh so DarkGold/BrightGold edits propagate without
				-- waiting for the next populate-driven refresh.
				table.insert(W.getThemed().evenDots, dot)
			end
		end

		-- Input field (after axis buttons)
		local inputOffset = #axes * (btnWidth + 2) + 2
		local inputWrap = W.makeBlob("InputWrap", row, UDim2.new(1,-inputOffset,1,0))
		inputWrap.Position = UDim2.new(0, inputOffset, 0, 0)
		local tb = Instance.new("TextBox"); tb.Name = "Input"; tb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tb.Text = ""; tb.PlaceholderText = placeholder or "value"
		tb.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; tb.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold; tb.Font = T.Font; tb.TextSize = 10
		tb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; tb.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		tb.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,1,0); tb.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); tb.BorderSizePixel = 0; tb.Parent = inputWrap

		local function getSelected()
			local result = {}
			for _, axis in ipairs(axes) do
				if selected[axis] then table.insert(result, key..axis) end
			end
			return result
		end

		local function setOnSelectionChanged(fn) _onSelChanged = fn end

		return {row = row, axisButtons = axBtns, evenButtons = evenBtns, input = tb,
			getSelected = getSelected, setOnSelectionChanged = setOnSelectionChanged}
	end

	-- link_axes: [Label] Pos [X][Y][Z]  Rot [X][Y][Z]  -  persisted per-axis toggles (item attributes).
	-- groups = { {prefix, attrs = {X = attrName, ...}}, ... }. Unlike the editing-target pills above the
	-- state lives on the items: setState(attrName, true/false/nil) repaints from Populate.
	function W.makeInlineAxisToggle(parent, key, groups)
		local frame = Instance.new("Frame"); frame.Name = key.."Toggles"; frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.ContentOffset, 0, LAYOUT.RowHeight); frame.Parent = parent
		local buttons = {}
		local paint = {}
		local x = 0
		for _, group in ipairs(groups) do
			local prefix = Instance.new("TextLabel"); prefix.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			prefix.Text = group.prefix; prefix.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; prefix.Font = T.Font; prefix.TextSize = 9
			prefix.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			prefix.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 1, 0); prefix.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 0); prefix.Parent = frame
			x += 24
			for _, axis in ipairs({"X", "Y", "Z"}) do
				local attrName = group.attrs[axis]
				local color = AXIS_COLORS[axis] or T.MutedGold
				local selBg = axisSelectedBg(color)
				local ab = Instance.new("TextButton"); ab.Name = attrName
				ab.BackgroundColor3 = selBg; ab.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
				ab.Text = axis; ab.TextColor3 = color; ab.Font = T.Font; ab.TextSize = 10
				ab.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18); ab.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0.5, -9)
				ab.BorderSizePixel = 0; ab.AutoButtonColor = false; ab.Parent = frame
				addCorner(ab, UDim.new(0, 3))
				ab:SetAttribute("_selected", true)
				trackAxis(ab, color, selBg)
				buttons[attrName] = ab
				paint[attrName] = function(state)
					ab:SetAttribute("_selected", state == true)
					if state == nil then
						ab.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; ab.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha; ab.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
					elseif state then
						ab.BackgroundColor3 = selBg; ab.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15; ab.TextColor3 = color
					else
						ab.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; ab.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha; ab.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
					end
				end
				x += 20
			end
			x += 6
		end
		local function setState(attrName, state)
			local fn = paint[attrName]
			if fn then fn(state) end
		end
		return { frame = frame, buttons = buttons, setState = setState }
	end
end

--[[
	WidgetDeck  -  mixin on Widgets: tool decks (several tool pages under one header with tabs that slide
	into view), the tray of collapsed panels under the HUD, and auto-tidy (selection tools fold into the
	tray while nothing is selected and come back on selection).

	W.makeDeck(sg, spec) -> { Frame, Pages = { key = frame }, api }
	  spec = { name, title?, titleWidth?, trayTitle?, width, minWidth?, pages = { { key, label, height }, ... } }
	  minWidth (default width) is how narrow the user may drag the deck; the tab chips must still fit it.
	  api  = show(key?), hide(), toggle(key?), setTab(key, animate?), activeKey(),
	         onShow(fn(key)), onHide(fn(key)), onTabChange(fn(fromKey, toKey))
	  Page frames fill the deck below its header, so page builders keep makeToolPanel's y offsets. A hidden
	  deck hides every page, so `page.Visible` always means "on screen" (QOLWiring and SelectionHandler read
	  it). The deck frame carries attribute ActiveTab (persisted by Modules/PanelPersistence); a page's
	  height follows the user's resizes while that page is active.
	W.makeTray(hud)                   the chip row under the HUD; call once.
	W.collapsePanel(panel, auto?)     hides a panel and adds its chip (attribute TrayTitle); auto marks it for autoTidy.
	W.restorePanel(panel)             shows it again (decks through their api).
	W.registerTidyPanel(panel)        selection tools that autoTidy folds while nothing is selected.
	W.autoTidy(hasSelection)
	W.makeChip(name, parent, text) / W.paintChip(button, on) / W.DeckSlide   the deck's tab chip and slide timing.
]]

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local T = C.T

local SLIDE = TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local HOVER_SWITCH_SECONDS = 0.1

return function(W)

local tray = nil
local tidyPanels = {}
local deckApis = {}

local function paintChip(button, on)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = on and T.Gold or T.BlobBg
	button.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or T.BlobAlpha
	button.TextColor3 = on and T.PanelBg or T.MutedGold
end

local function makeChip(name, parent, text)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name = name
	button.Text = text
	button.Font = T.Font
	button.TextSize = 8
	button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 14)
	button.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	button.AutoButtonColor = false
	button.ZIndex = 12
	button.Parent = parent
	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5)
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 5)
	padding.Parent = button
	W.addCorner(button, UDim.new(0, 7))
	W.addStroke(button)
	paintChip(button, false)
	return button
end

-- Shared with UIBuilder/PropertiesTabs, whose chips and page slides match a deck's.
W.makeChip = makeChip
W.paintChip = paintChip
W.DeckSlide = SLIDE

function W.makeDeck(sg, spec)
	local pages = spec.pages
	-- makeToolPanel takes its resize minimum from the build width, so build at the minimum and widen after.
	local frame = W.makeToolPanel(sg, spec.name, spec.minWidth or spec.width, pages[1].height)
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, spec.width, 0, pages[1].height)
	frame.Name = spec.name
	frame:SetAttribute("TrayTitle", spec.trayTitle or spec.title or spec.name)
	local header = frame:FindFirstChild("Hd")
	local title = header:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
	local titleWidth = 0
	if spec.title then
		title.Text = spec.title
		titleWidth = spec.titleWidth or 22
		title.Size = UDim2.new(0, titleWidth, 1, 0)
	else
		title.Visible = false
	end
	local strip = Instance.new("Frame")
	strip.Name = "Tabs"
	strip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	strip.Position = UDim2.new(0, titleWidth + 4, 0, 2)
	strip.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(titleWidth + 4 + 30), 1, -4)
	strip.ZIndex = 12
	strip.Parent = header
	local layout = W.addListLayout(strip, 3, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

	local pageFrames, tabs, heights, order = {}, {}, {}, {}
	for index, page in ipairs(pages) do
		local pageFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
		pageFrame.Name = page.key .. "Page"
		pageFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		pageFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		pageFrame.Visible = false
		pageFrame.ZIndex = 1
		pageFrame.Parent = frame
		pageFrames[page.key] = pageFrame
		heights[page.key] = page.height
		order[page.key] = index
		local tab = makeChip(page.key .. "Tab", strip, page.label)
		tab.LayoutOrder = index
		tabs[page.key] = tab
	end

	local active = nil
	local tweening = false
	local showListeners, hideListeners, tabListeners = {}, {}, {}
	local api = {}

	local function fire(list, ...)
		for _, fn in ipairs(list) do fn(...) end
	end

	local function syncPages()
		for key, pageFrame in pairs(pageFrames) do
			pageFrame.Visible = frame.Visible and key == active
			if not frame.Visible then pageFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) end
		end
	end

	-- Slide the new page in from the side it sits on in the strip and grow the deck to its height.
	function api.setTab(key, animate)
		local target = pageFrames[key]
		if not target then return end
		local fromKey = active
		if fromKey == key then
			syncPages()
			return
		end
		active = key
		frame:SetAttribute("ActiveTab", key)
		for tabKey, tab in pairs(tabs) do paintChip(tab, tabKey == key) end
		if not frame.Visible then
			syncPages()
			fire(tabListeners, fromKey, key)
			return
		end
		local direction = (order[key] >= (order[fromKey] or 0)) and 1 or -1
		local outgoing = fromKey and pageFrames[fromKey] or nil
		if animate then
			tweening = true
			target.Position = UDim2.new(direction, 0, 0, 0)
			target.Visible = true
			TweenService:Create(target, SLIDE, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) }):Play()
			local grow = TweenService:Create(frame, SLIDE, { Size = UDim2.new(0, frame.Size.X.Offset, 0, heights[key]) })
			grow.Completed:Connect(function() tweening = false end)
			grow:Play()
			if outgoing then
				local leave = TweenService:Create(outgoing, SLIDE, { Position = UDim2.new(-direction, 0, 0, 0) })
				leave.Completed:Connect(function()
					if active ~= fromKey then outgoing.Visible = false end
					outgoing.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
				end)
				leave:Play()
			end
		else
			frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, frame.Size.X.Offset, 0, heights[key])
			syncPages()
		end
		fire(tabListeners, fromKey, key)
	end

	function api.show(key)
		if key then api.setTab(key, false) end
		W.restoreChip(frame)
		frame.Visible = true
		task.defer(function() W.resolveOverlap(frame) end)
	end

	function api.hide()
		frame.Visible = false
	end

	-- The deck closes when its shown page is asked for again; any other page just comes forward.
	function api.toggle(key)
		if frame.Visible and (key == nil or key == active) then
			api.hide()
		else
			api.show(key)
		end
	end

	function api.activeKey() return active end
	function api.onShow(fn) table.insert(showListeners, fn) end
	function api.onHide(fn) table.insert(hideListeners, fn) end
	function api.onTabChange(fn) table.insert(tabListeners, fn) end

	-- Click switches at once; resting the cursor on a tab switches after a short hover.
	local hoverKey = nil
	for key, tab in pairs(tabs) do
		tab.Activated:Connect(function() api.setTab(key, true) end)
		tab.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			hoverKey = key
			task.delay(HOVER_SWITCH_SECONDS, function()
				if hoverKey == key and active ~= key and frame.Visible then api.setTab(key, true) end
			end)
		end)
		tab.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if hoverKey == key then hoverKey = nil end
		end)
	end
	table.insert(W.getThemed().repaints, function()
		for tabKey, tab in pairs(tabs) do paintChip(tab, tabKey == active) end
	end)
	frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
		if not tweening and frame.Visible and active then heights[active] = frame.Size.Y.Offset end
	end)
	-- Every visibility change (toggle, close X, collapse, persistence) keeps the pages in step.
	frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		syncPages()
		if frame.Visible then fire(showListeners, active) else fire(hideListeners, active) end
	end)
	api.setTab(pages[1].key, false)
	deckApis[frame] = api
	return { Frame = frame, Pages = pageFrames, api = api }
end

function W.makeTray(hud)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Tray"
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	frame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	frame.LayoutOrder = 1
	frame.Parent = hud
	local layout = W.addListLayout(frame, 3, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	pcall(function() layout.Wraps = true end)
	tray = { frame = frame, chips = {}, auto = {}, shown = {} }
	table.insert(W.getThemed().repaints, function()
		for _, chip in pairs(tray.chips) do paintChip(chip, false) end
	end)
	return frame
end

function W.restoreChip(panel)
	if not tray then return end
	local chip = tray.chips[panel]
	if not chip then return end
	chip:Destroy()
	tray.chips[panel] = nil
	tray.auto[panel] = nil
	local shownConn = tray.shown[panel]
	if shownConn then
		shownConn:Disconnect()
		tray.shown[panel] = nil
	end
end

function W.collapsePanel(panel, auto)
	if not tray or not panel.Visible then return end
	panel.Visible = false
	if tray.chips[panel] then return end
	local chip = makeChip("Chip", tray.frame, panel:GetAttribute("TrayTitle") or panel.Name)
	chip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 16)
	tray.chips[panel] = chip
	tray.auto[panel] = auto == true
	chip.Activated:Connect(function() W.restorePanel(panel) end)
	-- A panel shown by any other path (Q-menu, shortcut, toolbar) drops its chip.
	tray.shown[panel] = panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if panel.Visible then W.restoreChip(panel) end
	end)
end

function W.restorePanel(panel)
	W.restoreChip(panel)
	local api = deckApis[panel]
	if api then
		api.show()
	else
		panel.Visible = true
		task.defer(function() W.resolveOverlap(panel) end)
	end
end

function W.registerTidyPanel(panel)
	table.insert(tidyPanels, panel)
end

-- Nothing selected: fold the open selection tools into the tray; a selection brings those back
-- (panels the user folded by hand stay folded).
function W.autoTidy(hasSelection)
	if not tray then return end
	if hasSelection then
		local restore = {}
		for panel, isAuto in pairs(tray.auto) do
			if isAuto then table.insert(restore, panel) end
		end
		for _, panel in ipairs(restore) do W.restorePanel(panel) end
	else
		for _, panel in ipairs(tidyPanels) do
			if panel.Visible then W.collapsePanel(panel, true) end
		end
	end
end

end

--[[
	WidgetEvents  -  Properties-panel UI for the Events system.

	Builds a collapsible "Events" section inside the per-type Properties panel scroll.
	One row per supported event (OnEmit / OnDeath / OnDestruction / OnHit) shaped as:

		Hit Filter: [summary] [...]        (type-level; OnHit-capable types only)

		[Toggle] OnEmit -> Sparks · AtPosition
		   ├── description text
		   ├── Emit:    [Instance picker]
		   ├── Mode:    [AtPosition v] + one-line hint + in-place badge
		   ├── Script:  [Run Script toggle] [ Edit Script ]
		   ├── Chain:   [depth slider 1..32]
		   └── [ Reset Event ]

	Children frame is hidden when the event Enabled attribute is false. Selection-driven
	populate calls `setEnabled` / dropdown / picker refs to reflect the per-item state.

	Returns refs structured as:

		refs.Events = {
			_HitFilter = { row, label, dotsBtn },
			OnEmit = { row, toggle, fields, description, headerLabel, baseLabel, EmitTarget = {label, dotsBtn},
			           EmitMode = {dropdown, setOnChanged}, ModeHint, ModeBadge, ScriptEnabled = {toggle},
			           EditScript = TextButton, ChainDepth = {input, setVal, getVal},
			           ResetEvent = TextButton },
			OnDeath = { ... },
			...
		}

	The OnHit row is omitted for types where the event has no meaning per
	`EventsSchema.isValidForTypeName` (Beam / PointLight / screens / ImageLabel). We use the
	type-name variant because the section is built once per type, before any item exists.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT
local EventsSchema = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.EventsSchema)

local WidgetEvents = {}

local EVENT_LABELS = {
	OnEmit        = "On Emit",
	OnDeath       = "On Death",
	OnDestruction = "On Destruction",
	OnHit         = "On Hit",
}
local EVENT_DESCRIPTIONS = {
	OnEmit        = "Fires right after a particle clone spawns + enters the Heartbeat loop.",
	OnDeath       = "Fires when a particle's lifetime exhausts (each cycle if AnimateLoop=true).",
	OnDestruction = "Fires once just before the visual is destroyed (after PartLife linger).",
	OnHit         = "Fires per-frame on a sweep raycast hit between previous and current pose.",
}
-- Section build is per-type, not per-item, so we route through the schema's type-name
-- API. Skipping isValidForTypeName and hardcoding a local ONHIT table here would silently
-- drift the moment the schema's per-type validity changes (e.g. screen ImageLabel
-- gaining OnHit support post-v1).

local function makeBlobLabel(parent, text, size, color, font, sz)
	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Text = text
	lbl.TextColor3 = color or T.Gold
	lbl.Font = font or T.Font
	lbl.TextSize = sz or 9
	lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	lbl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	lbl.TextWrapped = true
	lbl.Size = size or UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18)
	lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
	lbl.BorderSizePixel = 0
	lbl.Parent = parent
	lbl.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	return lbl
end

local function makeBlobRowSlot(parent, label, contentSize)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.RowHeight)
	row.Parent = parent
	local lblBlob = W.makeBlob("L", row, UDim2.new(0, 60, 1, 0))
	W.makeLabel("L", lblBlob, label, T.MutedGold, T.Font, 8)
	local content = Instance.new("Frame")
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	content.BorderSizePixel = 0
	content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 64, 0, 0)
	content.Size = contentSize or UDim2.new(1, -64, 1, 0)
	content.Parent = row
	return row, content
end

-- Hit Filter row: summary label + "..." opening the HitFilterPanel. Wired by EventsConnectors.
local function buildHitFilterRow(parent)
	local row, content = makeBlobRowSlot(parent, "Hit Filter", nil)
	row.LayoutOrder = -1
	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Text = "(none)"
	lbl.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
	lbl.Font = T.Font
	lbl.TextSize = 9
	lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	lbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0)
	lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
	lbl.Parent = content
	local dotsBtn = W.makeButton("Dots", content, "...", UDim2.new(0, 18, 1, 0), T.DarkGold)
	dotsBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0)
	dotsBtn.TextSize = 11
	return { row = row, label = lbl, dotsBtn = dotsBtn }
end

-- Build one event block (toggle + children). Returns the refs sub-table for that event.
local function buildEventBlock(parent, eventName, layoutOrder)
	local block = Instance.new("Frame")
	block.Name = eventName .. "Block"
	block.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	block.BorderSizePixel = 0
	block.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	block.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	block.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
	block.Parent = parent
	W.addListLayout(block, 3)

	local refs = {}

	-- Top row: toggle + label.
	local headerRow = Instance.new("Frame")
	headerRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	headerRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
	headerRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.RowHeight)
	headerRow.LayoutOrder = 0
	headerRow.Parent = block
	local lblBlob = W.makeBlob("Lbl", headerRow, UDim2.new(1, -34, 1, 0))
	local headerLabel = W.makeLabel("L", lblBlob, EVENT_LABELS[eventName] or eventName, T.Gold, T.Font, 10)
	refs.headerLabel = headerLabel
	refs.baseLabel = EVENT_LABELS[eventName] or eventName
	local togBlob = W.makeBlob("TogBlob", headerRow, UDim2.new(0, 30, 1, 0))
	togBlob.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 0)
	-- makeToggle (NOT makeToggleInBlob): the latter wraps a fresh blob sized
	-- (1, -ContentOffset, 0, RowHeight) which is wider than our 30px container and
	-- collides with the label blob to its left.
	local tog = W.makeToggle("Toggle", togBlob)
	tog.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -14, 0.5, -8)
	refs.row = block
	refs.toggle = tog

	-- Children container  -  visibility tied to Enabled state via populate.
	local fields = Instance.new("Frame")
	fields.Name = "Fields"
	fields.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	fields.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fields.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	fields.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	fields.LayoutOrder = 1
	fields.Visible = false
	fields.Parent = block
	W.addListLayout(fields, 3)
	refs.fields = fields

	-- Untrusted-import badge. Hidden by default; Populate flips visibility when any
	-- selected item has cfg.ImportedUntrusted=true. Trust permits running but does
	-- NOT enable the event (toggle stays the enable action).
	local untrustedBadge = makeBlobLabel(fields,
		"Untrusted  -  review the script, then click Trust before this can run.",
		nil, T.Red or T.Gold, T.Font, 8)
	untrustedBadge.LayoutOrder = -1
	untrustedBadge.Visible = false
	refs.UntrustedBadge = untrustedBadge

	-- Description text.
	local desc = makeBlobLabel(fields, EVENT_DESCRIPTIONS[eventName] or "", nil, T.MutedGold, T.Font, 8)
	desc.LayoutOrder = 0
	refs.description = desc

	-- Emit picker row  -  cInstancePicker label + dotsBtn. Wired by EventsConnectors.
	-- FullName label + "..." button opens the instance-picker modal.
	local pickerRow, pickerContent = makeBlobRowSlot(fields, "Emit", nil)
	pickerRow.LayoutOrder = 1
	local pickerBlob = W.makeBlob("PickW", pickerContent, UDim2.new(1, -22, 1, 0))
	local pickerLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	pickerLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	-- TextLabel has no PlaceholderText (Studio raises invalid-property at build time).
	-- Empty-state is communicated via the literal "(none)" with a dimmed color, swapped
	-- to the live FullName + BrightGold by Populate when an EmitTarget exists.
	pickerLbl.Text = "(none)"
	pickerLbl.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
	pickerLbl.Font = T.Font; pickerLbl.TextSize = 9
	pickerLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	pickerLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	pickerLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, 0)
	pickerLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
	pickerLbl.Parent = pickerBlob
	local dotsBtn = W.makeButton("Dots", pickerContent, "...", UDim2.new(0, 18, 1, 0), T.DarkGold)
	dotsBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0)
	dotsBtn.TextSize = 11
	refs.EmitTarget = { label = pickerLbl, dotsBtn = dotsBtn }

	-- EmitMode dropdown.
	local modeRow, modeContent = makeBlobRowSlot(fields, "Mode", nil)
	modeRow.LayoutOrder = 2
	local modeBtn, modeFrame, modeSetOnChanged =
		W.makeDropdown("Mode", modeContent, { "AtPosition", "AtSource", "AtTarget", "AtCFrame" }, "AtPosition")
	modeFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	modeFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	refs.EmitMode = { dropdown = modeBtn, setOnChanged = modeSetOnChanged }

	-- One-line hint for the selected mode + a badge when the picked target cannot honour it.
	local modeHint = makeBlobLabel(fields, EventsSchema.EMIT_MODE_HINTS.AtPosition or "", nil, T.MutedGold, T.Font, 8)
	modeHint.LayoutOrder = 3

	-- ChainDepthLimit numeric input.
	local depthRow, depthContent = makeBlobRowSlot(fields, "Chain", nil)
	depthRow.LayoutOrder = 6
	local depthBlob = W.makeBlob("DW", depthContent, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0))
	local depthBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
	depthBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	depthBox.Text = "4"
	depthBox.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
	depthBox.Font = T.Font; depthBox.TextSize = 10
	depthBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	depthBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	depthBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, 0)
	depthBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
	depthBox.PlaceholderText = "1..32"
	depthBox.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold
	depthBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
	depthBox.Parent = depthBlob
	refs.ChainDepth = { input = depthBox }

	-- OnHit-only Collision dropdown. Off (default) = pass-through. Kill / Stop / Bounce
	-- change the particle's behavior at the hit point. Built only for OnHit since other
	-- events have no impact concept; OnHit itself is already restricted to Part /
	-- Attachment / Model via EventsSchema.VALID_PER_TYPE so type-gating is implicit.
	if eventName == "OnHit" then
		local collRow, collContent = makeBlobRowSlot(fields, "Collide", nil)
		collRow.LayoutOrder = 7
		local collBtn, collFrame, collSetOnChanged =
			W.makeDropdown("Collide", collContent, { "Off", "Kill", "Stop", "Bounce" }, "Off")
		collFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		collFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		refs.Collision = { dropdown = collBtn, setOnChanged = collSetOnChanged }

		-- Collision physics tunables (visible only when Collision == Bounce; Populate
		-- toggles row.Visible from the live cfg state). Kill/Stop modes don't consume
		-- these tunables so the rows stay hidden under those modes. Bounciness /
		-- Friction / Spin act as restitution / tangential damping / angular impulse
		-- coefficient respectively.
		local function makePhysicsRow(label, layoutOrder, default)
			local row, content = makeBlobRowSlot(fields, label, nil)
			row.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
			row.Visible = false
			local blob = W.makeBlob(label .. "W", content, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0))
			local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
			box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			box.Text = tostring(default)
			box.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
			box.Font = T.Font; box.TextSize = 10
			box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
			box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
			box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, 0)
			box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
			box.BorderSizePixel = 0
			box.Parent = blob
			return row, box
		end
		local bRow, bBox = makePhysicsRow("Bounce%",  8, 0.7)
		local fRow, fBox = makePhysicsRow("Friction", 9, 0.2)
		local sRow, sBox = makePhysicsRow("Spin",     10, 0.5)
		refs.Bounciness = { row = bRow, input = bBox }
		refs.Friction   = { row = fRow, input = fBox }
		refs.SpinAttr   = { row = sRow, input = sBox }

		-- OnHit raycast throttle. Independent of Collision mode (the OnHit fire itself
		-- gets gated, not just the bounce branch) so this row stays visible regardless
		-- of the Collision dropdown's value. 0 = check every Heartbeat tick (default,
		-- current behavior); higher values reduce per-particle raycast cost at the
		-- cost of tunneling between checks. Range clamped 0..0.5 by sanitize.
		local hRow, hBox = makePhysicsRow("HitTick", 11, 0)
		hRow.Visible = true
		refs.HitCheckInterval = { row = hRow, input = hBox }
	end

	-- Trust Script button. Hidden by default; Populate flips visible when any selected item
	-- has cfg.ImportedUntrusted=true. EventsConnectors calls EventsSchema.trustEvent on click.
	-- Trust permits running; user still flips Enabled separately.
	local trustBtn = W.makeButton("Trust", fields, "Trust Script",
		UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.RowHeight), T.Green or T.Gold)
	trustBtn.LayoutOrder = 12
	trustBtn.TextSize = 10
	trustBtn.Visible = false
	refs.TrustScript = trustBtn

	-- Reset Event button. Wired with confirm-then-fire in EventsConnectors.
	local resetBtn = W.makeButton("Reset", fields, "Reset Event",
		UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.RowHeight), T.Red)
	resetBtn.LayoutOrder = 13
	resetBtn.TextSize = 10
	refs.ResetEvent = resetBtn

	return refs
end

--- Build the Events section into `scrollParent` for a given type. Returns the events
--- refs sub-table the caller stores under refs.Events. `typeName` controls which event
--- rows are shown  -  OnHit is omitted for non-collision-bearing types.
function WidgetEvents.buildEventsSection(scrollParent, typeName, layoutOrder)
	local section, body = W.makeSection(scrollParent, "Events", layoutOrder, true)
	local refs = {}
	-- Type-level hit filter (OnHit, Rocks and Lightning raycasts share it). Above the event
	-- blocks so it stays reachable while OnHit is off.
	if EventsSchema.isValidForTypeName(typeName, "OnHit") then
		refs._HitFilter = buildHitFilterRow(body)
	end
	local order = 0
	for _, eventName in ipairs(EventsSchema.EVENT_NAMES) do
		if EventsSchema.isValidForTypeName(typeName, eventName) then
			refs[eventName] = buildEventBlock(body, eventName, order)
			order += 1
		end
	end
	refs._section = section
	refs._body = body
	return refs
end

return WidgetEvents

--[[
	WidgetPropToggles  -  Part-Icles V5
	Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle
	Prop toggle system for Clipboard/Shifter tool panels.
	Supports checkboxes, drag-select, select-all on headers, and checkbox propagation.
	Loaded by Widgets.luau  -  receives the shared W table and adds buildPropToggles to it.
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local T = C.T

return function(W)

local _dragConnection = nil
local _allDragStates = {}

function W.resetDragState()
	_allDragStates = {}
	if _dragConnection then _dragConnection:Disconnect(); _dragConnection = nil end
end

-- =========================================================
-- CHECKBOX HELPERS
-- =========================================================

local function makeChk(parent)
	local c = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	c.Name = "Chk"; c.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	c.Text = "☐"; c.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
	c.Font = T.Font; c.TextSize = 10
	c.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, 0)
	c.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	c.Position = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 0)
	c.ZIndex = 3; c.Parent = parent
	return c
end

local function setChk(chk, on)
	chk.Text = on and "☑" or "☐"
	chk.TextColor3 = on and T.Gold or T.DarkGold
end

-- Check if ALL descendants with "Selected" attribute are true
local function allSelected(body)
	for _, d in ipairs(body:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:GetAttribute("Selected") == false then return false end
	end
	return true
end

-- =========================================================
-- PROPERTY TOGGLE ROW
-- =========================================================

local function makePropToggle(parent, propName, layoutOrder, dragState, onChanged, displayNames)
	local row = W.makeBlob(propName .. "Tog", parent, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16))
	row.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
	row:SetAttribute("Selected", false); row:SetAttribute("PropRow", true)
	row:SetAttribute("PropKey", propName) -- raw key for clipboard/shift lookup

	local displayName = displayNames and displayNames[propName] or propName
	local label = W.makeLabel("L", row, displayName, T.MutedGold, T.Font, 8)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)

	local chk = makeChk(row)

	local function apply(sel)
		row:SetAttribute("Selected", sel)
		setChk(chk, sel)
		if onChanged then onChanged() end
	end

	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Name = "Click"; btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	btn.Text = ""; btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0); btn.Parent = row

	-- Click-drag pattern: MouseButton1Down toggles immediately AND arms drag mode in one event.
	-- Using Activated would wait for release, breaking the "click-and-sweep" UX where a drag
	-- across a row of toggles flips them all to the same state as the first-clicked toggle.
	-- dragState.mode is the new state of the FIRST click; subsequent MouseEnters apply that mode.
	btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		local newSel = not row:GetAttribute("Selected")
		dragState.active = true; dragState.mode = newSel
		apply(newSel)
	end)

	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		-- Skip apply when row already matches drag mode. Drag-select can fire
		-- MouseEnter many times for re-entered rows; without the skip each re-entry
		-- re-runs apply → onChanged → potentially O(N) work per row, total O(N×D).
		if dragState.active and row:GetAttribute("Selected") ~= dragState.mode then
			apply(dragState.mode)
		end
	end)
end

-- =========================================================
-- SUB-SECTION (category level: "Emission", "Appearance", etc.)
-- =========================================================

local function makeSubSection(parent, name, order)
	local container = Instance.new("Frame")
	container.Name = name:gsub("%s+", "") .. "Sub"
	container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	container.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	container.LayoutOrder = order; container.Parent = parent
	W.addListLayout(container, 0)

	-- Header blob
	local head = W.makeBlob("Header", container, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18))
	head.LayoutOrder = 0

	local arrow = W.makeLabel("Arrow", head, "▶", T.DarkGold, T.Font, 7)
	arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, 0); arrow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 0)

	W.makeLabel("Title", head, name, T.MutedGold, T.Font, 9).Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)

	-- Body
	local body = Instance.new("Frame")
	body.Name = "Body"; body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	body.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	body.LayoutOrder = 1; body.Visible = false; body.Parent = container
	W.addListLayout(body, 1); W.addPadding(body, 8, 2, 0, 0)

	-- Collapse toggle (arrow area only)
	local collapseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	collapseBtn.Name = "Toggle"; collapseBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	collapseBtn.Text = ""; collapseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, 0); collapseBtn.Parent = head
	collapseBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		body.Visible = not body.Visible
		arrow.Text = body.Visible and "▼" or "▶"
	end)

	return body, head
end

-- =========================================================
-- SELECT-ALL WIRING (for both type and sub-section headers)
-- =========================================================

local function wireSelectAll(head, body, arrowWidth, onChanged)
	local hchk = makeChk(head)

	-- Select-all button covers title area (right of arrow)
	local aw = arrowWidth or 18
	local selBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	selBtn.Name = "SelectAll"; selBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1; selBtn.Text = ""
	selBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -aw, 1, 0)
	selBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, aw, 0, 0)
	selBtn.ZIndex = 2; selBtn.Parent = head

	selBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		-- Determine target state: if any unselected → select all, else deselect all
		local on = not allSelected(body)

		-- Expand on select, collapse on deselect
		local ar = head:FindFirstChild("Arrow")
		body.Visible = on
		if ar then ar.Text = on and "▼" or "▶" end

		-- Apply to all property toggles and all nested checkboxes
		for _, d in ipairs(body:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:GetAttribute("Selected") ~= nil then d:SetAttribute("Selected", on) end
			if d.Name == "Chk" and d:IsA("TextLabel") then setChk(d, on) end
		end
		setChk(hchk, on)

		-- Notify parent to recompute its checkbox
		if onChanged then onChanged() end
	end)

	-- Return the checkbox so parent can refresh it
	return hchk
end

-- =========================================================
-- REFRESH HELPERS (checkbox propagation up the tree)
-- =========================================================

local function makeRefresher(body, chk)
	return function()
		setChk(chk, allSelected(body))
	end
end

-- =========================================================
-- PUBLIC: buildPropToggles
-- =========================================================

function W.buildPropToggles(parent, propList, sectionName, order, displayNames)
	local container, body, head = W.makeSection(parent, sectionName, order, false)

	-- Shared drag state for this type section
	local dragState = { active = false, mode = false }
	table.insert(_allDragStates, dragState)
	if not _dragConnection then
		_dragConnection = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				for _, ds in ipairs(_allDragStates) do ds.active = false end
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Type-level select-all (wired after sub-sections so propagation works)
	local typeChk = wireSelectAll(head, body)
	local refreshTypeChk = makeRefresher(body, typeChk)

	if #propList > 0 and type(propList[1]) == "table" then
		-- Sectioned clipboard: array of {name, props}
		for si, sec in ipairs(propList) do
			local secBody, secHead = makeSubSection(body, sec.name, si)
			local secChk = wireSelectAll(secHead, secBody, 14, refreshTypeChk)
			local refreshSecChk = makeRefresher(secBody, secChk)

			-- When a property changes → refresh category checkbox → refresh type checkbox
			local function onPropChanged()
				refreshSecChk()
				refreshTypeChk()
			end

			for pi, pn in ipairs(sec.props) do
				makePropToggle(secBody, pn, pi, dragState, onPropChanged, displayNames)
			end
		end
	else
		-- Flat list fallback
		for i, pn in ipairs(propList) do
			makePropToggle(body, pn, i, dragState, refreshTypeChk, displayNames)
		end
	end

	return container
end

end

-- =========================================================
-- LOW-LEVEL HELPERS
-- =========================================================
function Widgets.addCorner(p, r) local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = r or T.Corner; c.Parent = p; return c end
function Widgets.addStroke(p) local s = Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Color = T.Border; s.Transparency = T.BorderAlpha; s.Thickness = 1; s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; s.Parent = p; table.insert(_themed.strokes, s); return s end
function Widgets.addPadding(p, l, r, t, b) local pd = Instance.new("UIPadding"); pd.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,l or 6); pd.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,r or 6); pd.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0,t or 6); pd.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,b or 6); pd.Parent = p; return pd end
function Widgets.addListLayout(p, pad, dir, hA) local l = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); l.Padding = UDim.new(0,pad or 4); l.FillDirection = dir or Enum.FillDirection.Vertical; l.HorizontalAlignment = hA or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left; l.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; l.Parent = p; return l end

-- Decorative full-bleed background image for a panel. ZIndex=0 sits behind every default-
-- ZIndex sibling under the global Sibling ZIndexBehavior. Image + ImageTransparency driven by
-- T.BgImage / T.BgImageTransparency through UpdateTheme; the live ImageLabel is registered in
-- _themed.panelImages so theme refresh can reapply both fields on each change.
--
-- AutomaticSize panels (Settings, Properties, Theme Editor, HUD) can't host the ImageLabel
-- as a child with Size.Y.Scale=1 because UIListLayout's AbsoluteContentSize sums children's
-- AbsoluteSize.Y, AutomaticSize.Y grows the panel to that sum, ImageLabel grows with it,
-- AbsoluteContentSize grows again  -  divergent every frame. Park the ImageLabel as a SIBLING
-- of the panel inside the same ScreenGui ancestor and mirror Position / Size / Visible via
-- property-changed signals. UIScale on the ScreenGui scales render-time, so we divide the
-- absolute pixel coords by `_getScale(panel)` to keep overlay pixel-accurate.
function Widgets.attachPanelBackground(panel)
	-- Sibling overlay for ALL panels  -  never a child of the panel. Reasons:
	--   - Panels with UIListLayout would lay out the child ImageLabel into a layout slot,
	--     and AnchorPoint=(0.5,0.5)+Size=(1,0,1,0) would render half outside the panel.
	--   - AutomaticSize.Y panels would feedback-loop with a Size.Y.Scale=1 child.
	-- Park the overlay at the ScreenGui ancestor; mirror Position / Size / Visible via
	-- property-changed signals. UIScale.Scale divides absolute coords so the overlay
	-- stays pixel-aligned with the panel underneath.
	local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	img.Name = "PanelBackgroundImage"
	img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	img.BorderSizePixel = 0
	img.ZIndex = 0
	img.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	img.Image = T.BgImage or ""
	img.ImageTransparency = T.BgImageTransparency or 1
	img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	img.Visible = panel.Visible
	-- Match the panel's rounded corners so the overlay doesn't render as a square past
	-- the panel's UICorner edges. Read the panel's own UICorner radius if present, else
	-- default to BigCorner (most panels use BigCorner).
	local panelCorner = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	local imgCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	imgCorner.CornerRadius = panelCorner and panelCorner.CornerRadius or T.BigCorner
	imgCorner.Parent = img
	local function sync()
		if not panel.Parent then img.Visible = false; return end
		local sg = panel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
		if not sg then img.Visible = false; return end
		if img.Parent ~= sg then img.Parent = sg end
		local us = sg:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		local sc = (us and us.Scale ~= 0) and us.Scale or 1
		img.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(panel.AbsolutePosition.X / sc, panel.AbsolutePosition.Y / sc)
		img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(panel.AbsoluteSize.X / sc, panel.AbsoluteSize.Y / sc)
		img.Visible = panel.Visible
	end
	img.Parent = panel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui") or panel.Parent or panel
	sync()
	table.insert(_uisConnections, panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Parent"):Connect(sync))
	table.insert(_uisConnections, panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(sync))
	table.insert(_uisConnections, panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(sync))
	table.insert(_uisConnections, panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(sync))
	table.insert(_themed.panelImages, img)
	return img
end
-- Alias kept so any consumer using the panel-as-ImageLabel-style call still resolves.
Widgets.applyPanelBackground = Widgets.attachPanelBackground

function Widgets.makeToggle(name, parent)
	local outer = Instance.new("TextButton"); outer.Name = name; outer.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
	outer.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha; outer.Text = ""; outer.Size = UDim2.new(0,28,0,16)
	outer.BorderSizePixel = 0; outer.AutoButtonColor = false
	if parent then outer.Parent = parent end; addCorner(outer, UDim.new(0,8)); addStroke(outer); table.insert(_themed.toggles, outer)
	local dot = Instance.new("Frame"); dot.Name = "Dot"; dot.BackgroundColor3 = T.DarkGold

	dot.Parent = outer; addCorner(dot, UDim.new(0,6))
	outer:SetAttribute("IsOn", false)
	-- Visuals are driven by AttributeChanged so external SetAttribute (e.g. Randomizer
	-- section-header tristate "all-or-none" cycle) updates dot + bg in addition to
	-- clicks. Handling visuals only inside Activated would leave the toggle stuck on
	-- whichever look matched the previous click after an external SetAttribute.
	local function _applyToggleVisuals()

		outer:SetAttribute("IsOn", not (outer:GetAttribute("IsOn") == true))
	end)
	outer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsOn"):Connect(_applyToggleVisuals)
	return outer
end

-- Inline expandable dropdown options
local _activeDropdownExpansion = nil
local _activeDropdownBtn = nil
local _activeDropdownArrow = nil
local _dropdownOptButtons = {}
-- Tracks the ScrollingFrame whose ScrollingEnabled was forced false by a hover-
-- on-dropdown so callers that close the dropdown out-of-band (selection change,
-- panel close) can restore it instead of waiting for an unrelated MouseLeave.
local _hoverScrollDisabled = nil

local function hideDropdownExpansion()
	if _activeDropdownExpansion then
		_activeDropdownExpansion:Destroy()
		_activeDropdownExpansion = nil
	end
	if _activeDropdownArrow then _activeDropdownArrow.Text = "\u{25BC}" end
	if _hoverScrollDisabled and _hoverScrollDisabled.Parent then
		_hoverScrollDisabled.ScrollingEnabled = true
	end
	_hoverScrollDisabled = nil
	_activeDropdownBtn = nil
	_activeDropdownArrow = nil
	_dropdownOptButtons = {}
end
Widgets.hideDropdownExpansion = hideDropdownExpansion

local function _dropdownHL() return Color3.new(math.min(T.BlobBg.R+0.08,1), math.min(T.BlobBg.G+0.09,1), math.min(T.BlobBg.B+0.06,1)) end
local function updateDropdownHighlight(selectedIdx)
	local hl = _dropdownHL()
	for i, ob in ipairs(_dropdownOptButtons) do
		ob.BackgroundColor3 = (i == selectedIdx) and hl or T.BlobBg
		ob.BackgroundTransparency = (i == selectedIdx) and 0.1 or T.BlobAlpha
		ob.TextColor3 = (i == selectedIdx) and T.BrightGold or T.MutedGold
	end
end

function Widgets.makeDropdown(name, parent, options, default)
	-- TextButton wrapper  -  Active=true by default
	local f = Instance.new("TextButton"); f.Name = name.."Wrap"
	f.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; f.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	f.Text = ""; f.Size = UDim2.new(1,-LAYOUT.ContentOffset,0,LAYOUT.RowHeight)
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0; f.AutoButtonColor = false
	if parent then f.Parent = parent end
	addCorner(f); addStroke(f); table.insert(_themed.blobs, f)

	-- Hover-delay gate for wheel cycling. Mouse must rest on the dropdown for at
	-- least SCROLL_HOVER_DELAY seconds before the wheel cycles options; prevents
	-- accidental cycling when the user scrolls the parent panel past a dropdown.
	-- 0 sentinel = not hovering.
	local _hoverEnterAt = 0
	local SCROLL_HOVER_DELAY = 0.2

	-- Disable parent scroll when hovering dropdown so MouseWheel only cycles options
	-- PropertiesTabs switches its page host back on at every page change: a dropdown can leave with its page.
	f.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		_hoverEnterAt = os.clock()
		local scroll = f:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
		if scroll then
			scroll.ScrollingEnabled = false
			_hoverScrollDisabled = scroll
		end
	end)
	f.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		_hoverEnterAt = 0
		local scroll = f:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
		if scroll then scroll.ScrollingEnabled = true end
		if _hoverScrollDisabled == scroll then _hoverScrollDisabled = nil end
	end)

	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); lbl.Name = name; lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Text = default or options[1] or ""; lbl.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; lbl.Font = T.Font; lbl.TextSize = 10
	lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-16,1,0); lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0)
	lbl.Parent = f

	-- Arrow indicator
	local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel"); arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	arrow.Text = "\u{25BC}"; arrow.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; arrow.Font = T.Font; arrow.TextSize = 7
	arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0,10,1,0); arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1,-10,0,0); arrow.Parent = f

	local idx = 1; for i, o in ipairs(options) do if o == default then idx = i; break end end
	local _onChanged = nil

	local function setValue(newIdx)
		idx = newIdx; lbl.Text = options[idx]
		if _onChanged then _onChanged(options[idx]) end
	end

	-- Scroll on hover: cycle options. Gated by SCROLL_HOVER_DELAY so a brief mouse
	-- pass while the parent panel is being scrolled doesn't accidentally cycle the
	-- dropdown. Deliberate scroll (mouse rests >=0.2s) cycles normally.
	f.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then return end
		if _hoverEnterAt == 0 or (os.clock() - _hoverEnterAt) < SCROLL_HOVER_DELAY then return end
		if input.Position.Z > 0 then
			idx = idx % #options + 1
		else
			idx = (idx - 2) % #options + 1
		end
		setValue(idx)
		if _activeDropdownBtn == f then
			updateDropdownHighlight(idx)
		end
	end)

	-- Click: expand inline options list below the row
	f.Activated:Connect(function()
		if _activeDropdownBtn == f then
			hideDropdownExpansion(); return
		end
		hideDropdownExpansion()
		_activeDropdownBtn = f
		_activeDropdownArrow = arrow
		arrow.Text = "\u{25B2}" -- up arrow

		-- Parent to ScreenGui so it escapes ScrollingFrame clipping
		local sg = f:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
		if not sg then return end

		-- AbsolutePosition is in screen pixels; divide by UIScale to get ScreenGui coordinates
		local scale = 1
		local uiScaleObj = sg:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		if uiScaleObj then scale = uiScaleObj.Scale end

		local absPos = f.AbsolutePosition
		local absSize = f.AbsoluteSize

		local optFrame = Instance.new("Frame"); optFrame.Name = name.."Options"
		optFrame.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; optFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
		optFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, absPos.X / scale, 0, (absPos.Y + absSize.Y) / scale)
		optFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, absSize.X / scale, 0, 0)
		optFrame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		-- ZIndex 250 keeps the option list above modal panels (HitFilterPanel,
		-- ConfigPanel) which sit at ZIndex 200. ScreenGui uses Sibling z-order,
		-- so the expansion must beat both the modal frame AND its children.
		optFrame.ZIndex = 250; optFrame.ClipsDescendants = false
		optFrame.Parent = sg
		addCorner(optFrame, T.Corner); addStroke(optFrame)
		addListLayout(optFrame, 1)

		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4); pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
		pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 3); pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 3)
		pad.Parent = optFrame

		_activeDropdownExpansion = optFrame
		_dropdownOptButtons = {}

		for i, opt in ipairs(options) do
			local ob = Instance.new("TextButton"); ob.Name = "Opt"..i
			ob.BackgroundColor3 = (i == idx) and _dropdownHL() or T.BlobBg
			ob.BackgroundTransparency = (i == idx) and 0.1 or T.BlobAlpha
			ob.Text = opt; ob.TextColor3 = (i == idx) and T.BrightGold or T.MutedGold
			ob.Font = T.Font; ob.TextSize = 9; ob.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			ob.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18); ob.BorderSizePixel = 0; ob.LayoutOrder = i
			ob.AutoButtonColor = true; ob.ZIndex = 250; ob.Parent = optFrame
			addCorner(ob, UDim.new(0,3))
			table.insert(_dropdownOptButtons, ob)
			ob.Activated:Connect(function()
				setValue(i)
				hideDropdownExpansion()
			end)
		end

		-- Flip upward if dropdown would clip below viewport
		local estimatedH = #options * 19 + 6
		local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
		if vp then
			local bottomEdge = (absPos.Y + absSize.Y) / scale + estimatedH
			if bottomEdge > vp.Y / scale then
				optFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, absPos.X / scale, 0, (absPos.Y - estimatedH) / scale)
			end
		end
	end)

	local function setOnChanged(fn) _onChanged = fn end
	return lbl, f, setOnChanged
end

-- =========================================================
-- PANEL TRACKING / DRAG / SNAP
-- =========================================================
function Widgets.registerPanel(panel)
	table.insert(_allPanels, panel)
end

local function _getScale(i) local sg = i:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
	if sg then local us = sg:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"); if us then return us.Scale end end; return 1 end

-- Panels overlap freely. Only auto-correction is the viewport clamp below which keeps
-- panels reachable when dragged off-screen. `_allPanels` + `_noSnap` attributes are
-- reserved for future opt-out / scale helpers; neither suppresses the clamp.
-- Settings "Snap Panels In View" toggle drives EdgeSnapEnabled (QOLWiring hydrates it).
Widgets.EdgeSnapEnabled = true
function Widgets.resolveOverlap(panel, _depth, _vp)
	if Widgets.EdgeSnapEnabled == false then return end
	if not panel.Visible then return end
	-- Modules/Workspaces parks a panel off-screen on purpose; clamping would pull it back.
	if panel:GetAttribute("_workspaceParked") then return end
	local scale = _getScale(panel)
	local vp = _vp or (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080))
	local pw, ph = panel.AbsoluteSize.X, panel.AbsoluteSize.Y
	-- Clamp to viewport  -  keeps panels reachable even when dragged off-screen.
	local vpS = vp / scale
	local aX, aY = panel.AbsolutePosition.X / scale, panel.AbsolutePosition.Y / scale
	local cX = math.clamp(aX, 0, math.max(vpS.X - pw/scale, 0))
	local cY = math.clamp(aY, 0, math.max(vpS.Y - ph/scale, 0))
	if math.abs(cX-aX) > 1 or math.abs(cY-aY) > 1 then local p = panel.Position
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset+(cX-aX), p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset+(cY-aY)) end
end

function Widgets.makeDraggable(frame, handle)
	local dragging = false
	local ds, sp, dragScale
	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = true; ds = i.Position; sp = frame.Position; dragScale = _getScale(frame)
		end
	end)
	handle.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = false
			task.defer(function() Widgets.resolveOverlap(frame) end)
		end
	end)
	local c1 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if dragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			local d = i.Position - ds
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, sp.X.Offset + d.X / dragScale, sp.Y.Scale, sp.Y.Offset + d.Y / dragScale)
		end
	end)
	local c2 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = false
			task.defer(function() Widgets.resolveOverlap(frame) end)
		end
	end)
	table.insert(_uisConnections, c1); table.insert(_uisConnections, c2)
end

-- Toast notification system. Used for transient error / info messages that need to
-- surface to the user without forcing a modal (e.g. "Model has no PrimaryPart").
-- Stacks vertically in the bottom-right of the plugin's main ScreenGui. Auto-
-- dismisses after `duration` seconds. Severity controls the accent stripe color:
-- "info" (gold), "warn" (orange), "error" (red).
local _toastStack = {} -- active toasts, top of stack = bottom of screen
local _toastSG -- ScreenGui parent (lazy-initialized once we have ctx)

-- Set the parent ScreenGui (called once from init.server.lua / UIBuilder).
function Widgets.setToastParent(sg) _toastSG = sg end

local TOAST_W, TOAST_H, TOAST_PAD = 240, 48, 8

local function _repositionToasts()
	for i, toast in ipairs(_toastStack) do
		toast.Position = UDim2.new(1, -TOAST_W - 16, 1, -16 - i * (TOAST_H + TOAST_PAD))
	end
end

function Widgets.showToast(message, severity, duration)
	if not _toastSG then Log.warn("[Part-Icles] showToast called before setToastParent: " .. tostring(message)); return end
	severity = severity or "info"
	duration = duration or 4
	local accentColor = severity == "error" and Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 60)
		or severity == "warn" and Color3.fromRGB(220, 150, 60)
		or T.Gold

	local toast = Instance.new("Frame")
	toast.Name = "Toast"; toast.Size = UDim2.new(0, TOAST_W, 0, TOAST_H)
	toast.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	toast.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; toast.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
	toast.BorderSizePixel = 0; toast.ZIndex = 50; toast.Parent = _toastSG
	Widgets.addCorner(toast, T.Corner)
	Widgets.addStroke(toast)

	local stripe = Instance.new("Frame"); stripe.Name = "Accent"
	stripe.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, 0); stripe.BorderSizePixel = 0
	stripe.BackgroundColor3 = accentColor; stripe.ZIndex = 51; stripe.Parent = toast
	Widgets.addCorner(stripe, UDim.new(0, 2))

	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); lbl.Name = "Msg"; lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0); lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
	lbl.Text = tostring(message); lbl.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; lbl.Font = T.Font; lbl.TextSize = 11
	lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; lbl.TextWrapped = true; lbl.ZIndex = 51; lbl.Parent = toast

	table.insert(_toastStack, toast)
	_repositionToasts()

	task.delay(duration, function()
		if toast and toast.Parent then
			for i, t in ipairs(_toastStack) do
				if t == toast then table.remove(_toastStack, i); break end
			end
			pcall(function() toast:Destroy() end)
			_repositionToasts()
		end
	end)
end

-- enableTextScaling removed: professional tool UIs use fixed text sizes.
-- Panel resizing changes input/content width, not font size. Overflow
-- handled by TextTruncate + minimum panel widths in makeResizable.

-- EDGE RESIZE (hover edge → inner glow → drag to resize)
function Widgets.makeResizable(panel, minW, minH)
	minW = minW or 80; minH = minH or 60
	local EDGE_W = 12; local HOVER_DELAY = 0.4; local CR = T.BigCorner.Offset
	local GLOW_W = 6
	local GLOW_ROTATION = { L = 0, R = 180, T = 90, B = 270 }
	-- Handles reach HW into the content area; PropertiesTabs keeps its side strips that far in (EDGE_CLEARANCE).
	local HW = EDGE_W / 2
	local fadeIn = TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local fadeOut = TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local edges = {
		{name="R", size=UDim2.new(0,EDGE_W,1,0), pos=UDim2.new(1,-HW,0,0), ax="x", dir=1},
		{name="L", size=UDim2.new(0,EDGE_W,1,0), pos=UDim2.new(0,-HW,0,0), ax="x", dir=-1, moveAxis=true},
		{name="B", size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,EDGE_W), pos=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-HW), ax="y", dir=1},
		{name="T", size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,EDGE_W), pos=UDim2.new(0,0,0,-HW), ax="y", dir=-1, moveAxis=true},
	}
	for _, edge in ipairs(edges) do
		local handle = Instance.new("TextButton"); handle.Name = "Edge_"..edge.name
		handle.BackgroundTransparency = 1; handle.Text = ""; handle.Size = edge.size
		handle.Position = edge.pos; handle.ZIndex = 8; handle.BorderSizePixel = 0
		handle.AutoButtonColor = false; handle.Parent = panel
		-- Inner glow along the hovered edge: lives inside the panel (never over neighbours), inset by
		-- the corner radius, fading inward through a UIGradient. Relative sizing follows moves / resizes.
		local highlight = Instance.new("Frame"); highlight.Name = "EHL_"..edge.name
		highlight.BackgroundColor3 = T.Gold; highlight.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		highlight.BorderSizePixel = 0; highlight.Visible = false; highlight.ZIndex = 50
		highlight.Parent = panel
		local glow = Instance.new("UIGradient"); glow.Rotation = GLOW_ROTATION[edge.name]
		glow.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
		glow.Parent = highlight

		local hoverTimer, activated, resizing = nil, false, false
		local startMouse, startSize, startPos, scale, sizeScale

		-- Children sit inside the panel's UIPadding, so the glow backs out of it to reach the true edge.
		local function positionHighlight()
			if not panel.Parent then return end
			local pad = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
			local padL = pad and pad.PaddingLeft.Offset or 0
			local padR = pad and pad.PaddingRight.Offset or 0
			local padT = pad and pad.PaddingTop.Offset or 0
			local padB = pad and pad.PaddingBottom.Offset or 0
			highlight.BackgroundColor3 = T.Gold
			if edge.name == "R" then highlight.Position = UDim2.new(1, padR - GLOW_W, 0, CR - padT); highlight.Size = UDim2.new(0, GLOW_W, 1, padT + padB - CR*2)
			elseif edge.name == "L" then highlight.Position = UDim2.new(0, -padL, 0, CR - padT); highlight.Size = UDim2.new(0, GLOW_W, 1, padT + padB - CR*2)
			elseif edge.name == "B" then highlight.Position = UDim2.new(0, CR - padL, 1, padB - GLOW_W); highlight.Size = UDim2.new(1, padL + padR - CR*2, 0, GLOW_W)
			elseif edge.name == "T" then highlight.Position = UDim2.new(0, CR - padL, 0, -padT); highlight.Size = UDim2.new(1, padL + padR - CR*2, 0, GLOW_W) end
		end

		handle.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if resizing then return end
			hoverTimer = task.delay(HOVER_DELAY, function()
				positionHighlight(); highlight.Visible = true; activated = true
				TweenService:Create(highlight, fadeIn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.2}):Play()
			end)
		end)
		handle.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if hoverTimer then task.cancel(hoverTimer); hoverTimer = nil end
			if not resizing then
				activated = false
				local tw = TweenService:Create(highlight, fadeOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}); tw:Play()
				tw.Completed:Once(function() if not activated then highlight.Visible = false end end)
			end
		end)
		handle.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			if not activated then return end
			resizing = true; scale = _getScale(panel)
			-- Size.Offset is rendered through the panel's own UIScale (if any); Position.Offset is not.
			local ownScale = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
			sizeScale = scale * (ownScale and ownScale.Scale or 1)
			startMouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			startSize = panel.Size; startPos = panel.Position; positionHighlight()
		end)
		local c1 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if not resizing or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
			local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			local dx, dy = (mouse.X - startMouse.X) / sizeScale, (mouse.Y - startMouse.Y) / sizeScale
			local posRatio = sizeScale / scale
			local w, h, px, py = startSize.X.Offset, startSize.Y.Offset, startPos.X.Offset, startPos.Y.Offset
			if edge.ax == "x" then local nW = math.max(minW, w+dx*edge.dir); panel.Size = UDim2.new(0,nW,startSize.Y.Scale,h); if edge.moveAxis then panel.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale,px+(w-nW)*posRatio,startPos.Y.Scale,py) end
			else local nH = math.max(minH, h+dy*edge.dir); panel.Size = UDim2.new(startSize.X.Scale,w,0,nH); if edge.moveAxis then panel.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale,px,startPos.Y.Scale,py+(h-nH)*posRatio) end end
			positionHighlight()
		end)
		local c2 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and resizing then
				resizing = false; activated = false
				local tw = TweenService:Create(highlight, fadeOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}); tw:Play()
				tw.Completed:Once(function() highlight.Visible = false end)
				task.defer(function() Widgets.resolveOverlap(panel) end)
			end
		end)
		table.insert(_uisConnections, c1); table.insert(_uisConnections, c2)
	end
end

	function W.makeSlider(parent, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal, onChanged, fmt, logScale)
		fmt = fmt or "%.2f"
		local c = Instance.new("Frame"); c.Name = "Slider"; c.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		c.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,28); c.Parent = parent
		local valLbl = Instance.new("TextBox"); valLbl.Name = "Val"; valLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		valLbl.Text = string.format(fmt, defaultVal); valLbl.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		valLbl.Font = T.Font; valLbl.TextSize = 16; valLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		valLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,16); valLbl.ClearTextOnFocus = false; valLbl.BorderSizePixel = 0; valLbl.Parent = c
		local track = W.makeBlob("Track", c, UDim2.new(1,-4,0,6)); track.Position = UDim2.new(0,2,0,18)
		local fill = Instance.new("Frame"); fill.Name = "Fill"; fill.BackgroundColor3 = T.SliderFill or Color3.fromRGB(180,60,60)
		fill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3; fill.BorderSizePixel = 0; fill.Size = UDim2.new(0.5,0,1,0); fill.Parent = track
		addCorner(fill, UDim.new(0,3)); table.insert(W.getThemed().fills, fill)
		local handle = Instance.new("TextButton"); handle.Name = "Handle"
		handle.BackgroundColor3 = T.BrightGold; handle.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
		handle.Text = ""; handle.Size = UDim2.new(0,8,0,10); handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-4,0,-2)
		handle.BorderSizePixel = 0; handle.Parent = track; addCorner(handle, UDim.new(0,4))
		-- Log-scale helpers (for multiplicative sliders like resize/retime: 0.5x–2x with 1x centered)
		local logRatio = logScale and math.log(maxVal / minVal) or 0
		local function valToAlpha(v)
			if logScale then return math.clamp(math.log(v / minVal) / logRatio, 0, 1) end
			return math.clamp((v - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1)
		end
		local function alphaToVal(a)
			if logScale then return minVal * math.exp(a * logRatio) end
			return minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * a
		end
		local cur = defaultVal
		local function setVal(v, silent)
			cur = v
			local a = valToAlpha(v); fill.Size = UDim2.new(a,0,1,0)
			handle.Position = UDim2.new(a,-4,0,-2); valLbl.Text = string.format(fmt, v)
			if not silent and onChanged then onChanged(v) end
		end
		local dragging = false
		local function upd(input) local ap = track.AbsolutePosition.X; local as = track.AbsoluteSize.X
			if as == 0 then return end; setVal(alphaToVal(math.clamp((input.Position.X-ap)/as,0,1)))
		end
		handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true end end)
		handle.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end end)
		track.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true; upd(i) end end)
		local c1 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i) if dragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then upd(i) end end)
		local c2 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end end)
		local uisC = W.getUISConnections(); table.insert(uisC, c1); table.insert(uisC, c2)
		-- Manual text input: allow values outside slider range (negatives + zero too); visual clamps to edges.
		valLbl.FocusLost:Connect(function() local raw = valLbl.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]",""); local n = tonumber(raw); if n then setVal(n) end end)
		setVal(defaultVal, true)
		return c, valLbl, setVal, function() return cur end
	end

	-- Adds a small `*` config-icon button to the row's LabelBlob and stores it on the row's ref

	local function addConfigCog(refTable, rowFrame, d)
